jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
At Nuwave, we are committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions in the wireless telecom industry. With a focus on innovation, safety, and excellence, we partner with leading providers to build and maintain the networks that keep our world connected. Whether it’s streamlining site acquisition or executing complex construction projects, our talented team is at the forefront of the industry. This role is a full-time, in-office position based out of our Signal Hill, CA headquarters.

We're expanding our Southern California PMO and seeking experienced Project Coordinators at the I, II, and III levels to support our Project Management team on wireless deployments across LA, Orange County, Inland Empire, and San Diego areas. Your level will be determined by your experience, demonstrated ownership of coordination details, and track record supporting project execution.

If you're ready to advance your career with a company that values teamwork, integrity, and your professional development, we want to hear from you! Please complete the online application included in this job posting. If you have any questions, feel free to email us at employment@nuwavecom.com

We are seeking experienced Project Coordinators to support Project Managers and Construction Managers in the day-to-day implementation of wireless telecommunications construction projects, including maintaining project trackers, folders, and documentation; scheduling; coordinating permitting; and supporting the closeout packages (COP). jobs.description:
**About Young & Healthy**

Through prevention, education, family support, and access to healthcare services, Young & Healthy protects and improves the physical and mental health of uninsured and underinsured children and their families in the greater Pasadena area. The problem with healthcare services in the Pasadena area is not one of availability, but of affordability and accessibility. One of the greatest obstacles to good health is poverty. In the Pasadena community, about one-third of the children are in need of the kind of care Young & Healthy provides. The majority of children under age 18 and enrolled in Pasadena Unified Schools live in areas of town that claim the lowest per capita income and the greatest concentration of poverty.

Young & Healthy’s model is simple: people helping people. Through collaboration with other community institutions, Young & Healthy makes it a point to know the community and be known by the community so that knowledge and resources can be maximized among community partners to assist the greatest number of neighbors in need.

Young & Healthy is now sustained by the generosity of a volunteer workforce of more than 350 healthcare professionals, over 125 community volunteers and an extensive network of community partners to provide free healthcare to needy underserved children. These professional volunteers agree to see children in their own private offices, on a rotating basis, at no charge to the patient or to Young & Healthy. Young & Healthy facilitates the delivery of donated medical, dental, mental health and other healthcare services, free-of-charge, to underserved low-income children, ranging in age from infancy to 18 years, throughout the greater Pasadena area. In addition to healthcare support, Young & Healthy offers these additional services to the community:

**Health Insurance Assistance** – Young & Healthy helps to prepare families to enroll in and navigate the healthcare system by assisting with health insurance enrollment, providing education and instruction, as well as advocating for clients when they have been wrongfully denied.

**Trauma Informed Care** - Young & Healthy is committed to creating a healthy community for children and families by educating children, parents, and educators on how to become more aware of and sensitive to those who have suffered trauma. Through parent education and professional development for teachers, Young & Healthy staff offers a series of trainings on trauma informed care to the public, Pasadena Unified School District staff and administrators, and others.

**Position Overview**

The Program Coordinator is responsible for the insurance enrollment, navigation, and insurance support services of clients referred to Young & Healthy.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

**1. Insurance Services**

a. Provide clients with health insurance information, application, and navigation.

b. Assist clients with accessing, understanding, and utilizing health insurance.

c. Continuously update their knowledge base about community services and discover ways for Young & Healthy and our clients to use those services.

d. Identify and communicate to the Program Director newly identified client needs, gaps in services, successes, and issues with case management.

e. Attend and fully participate in the Care Team and all other office meetings for which their attendance is required.

Participate in community networking activities.

**2. Professional Development**

a. Constantly increases knowledge as it relates to the services Young & Healthy provides to the community

**Qualifications:** The qualifications described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made upon request to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this position.

**1.**  **Education/Experience**

a. B.A. or B.S. preferred

b. A minimum of 3 years of employment or volunteer activities with a non-profit agency

**2. Special knowledge, skills, and abilities**

a. Must be bilingual in English and Spanish

b. Ability to fluently read, write, and speak English

c. Ability to be flexible, meet deadlines and work effectively under stress

d. Demonstrated leadership skills

e. Ability to work with diverse populations

f. Strong written and oral communication skills

g. Must be detail oriented

h. Strong and positive interpersonal skills, ability to resolve conflicts

i. Ability to organize work, prioritize multiple tasks, and follow through on own initiative

j. Good organizational skills

k. Experience in non-profit organizations

l. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office Suite

m. Experience with FAMCare software or other client-based software

**3. Physical Requirements**

a. Must be able to speak and hear

b. Must be able to lift 20 pounds

c. Must have sufficient stamina to work long hours, sit or stand for long periods, and concentrate for long periods of time

d. Evening and weekend work may be required

jobs.description:
**Finance & Operations Coordinator**

Reports To: Deputy Director

Employment Type: Full-Time, Exempt

Compensation: $60,000 **-** 80,000 annually, commensurate with experience

Location: Los Angeles, CA — in-person required for all events and volunteer days; hybrid otherwise

Target Start: November 2026

Direct Reports: None

The Los Angeles Parks Foundation (LAPF) is the primary nonprofit partner of the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP). Founded in 2008, LAPF raises private philanthropic support to enhance, expand, and champion the more than 500 parks and recreation centers stewarded by the City of Los Angeles.

LAPF is in an active growth phase, guided by a new 2026–2030 Strategic Plan and led by President & CEO Amber Martinez. The organization currently operates with a small staff and program and administrative consultants and is building toward a full operational team. The Administration & Grants Coordinator is a foundational hire — the role that keeps the day-to-day running smoothly so that program and development staff can focus on mission-driven work.

The Finance and Operations Coordinator supports the financial and operational functions of LAPF under the direction of the Deputy Director. This role is the organizational engine behind LAPF’s day-to-day administration: processing transactions, maintaining records, managing office systems, supporting the external accountant, and ensuring that the organization’s financial and operational infrastructure runs accurately and on time.

LAPF works with an external accountant for bookkeeping and tax filings. The Finance and Operations Coordinator is the internal point of contact for that relationship, gathering documentation, processing receipts and invoices, and ensuring the accountant has what they need to produce clean and timely financial reports. The Deputy Director reviews financial statements and manages the budget; this role supports that process with accurate, well-organized underlying data.

This is a detail-oriented, systems-minded role in a small, mission-driven organization. The right person takes pride in accurate records, well-run processes, and a tidy office — and finds satisfaction in being the person the rest of the team can count on to keep things organized.

Time is allocated across four functional areas as follows:

Area % Focus

**Operations and Office Administration 30%**

Invoice processing, receipts, reimbursements, 12% fee tracking, external accountant support

**Financial Administration & Payment Processing 35%**

Accounts payable, Bill.com payments, reimbursements, revenue documentation, administrative fee tracking, external accountant coordination, grant expenditure tracking, and audit support

**Grants, Accounts & Reporting Processing 20%**

Friends of Parks and Special Projects administration, grant deliverables and reporting deadlines, CRM and donor records, account reporting, and data management

**Board and Executive Support 15%**

Board and committee coordination, drafting materials and minutes, organizational scheduling and meeting logistics,

**1. Operations and Office Administration (30%)**

The Finance and Operations Coordinator is responsible for the day-to-day administration of LAPF’s office and internal operations, ensuring that staff have the systems supplies, equipment, and administrative support needed to work effectively. jobs.description:

Somos Group brings together legal and consulting professionals to help public- and private-sector clients solve complex challenges involving cities, development, and communities. We are a minority- and woman-owned business with deep community connections that believes the built environment is a tool for healing and promoting human potential. With offices in Los Angeles, San Francisco, and Mexico City, we work across disciplines to support community resilience, economic development, and social equity.

**About the Position**

Somos Group is seeking an organized, detail-oriented Accounts Payable/Receivable & Administrative Coordinator to join our Administration and Operations team.

This position supports day-to-day financial operations, maintains accurate records, and helps keep payments, approvals, and administrative processes moving. The ideal candidate follows through consistently, communicates clearly, and takes ownership of recurring responsibilities. You should be comfortable working with numbers, tracking outstanding items, and asking questions when something does not look right.

* Strong attention to detail and the ability to review your work for accuracy.

* Proficiency with Microsoft 365, including Outlook, Teams, and Excel.
* Ability to handle confidential financial, employee, and client information with discretion.
* Comfortable learning new systems, following established procedures, and identifying issues that need attention.

**Client Care Coordinator - New Client Sales & Client Relations**

**Comfort Keepers – Huntington Beach, CA**

**Job Type:** Full-Time

**Pay:** Competitive compensation based on experience

**Schedule:** Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM, with rotating weeknight and weekend on-call responsibilities

**Location:** Huntington Beach, CA

**Make a Difference Every Day with Comfort Keepers!**

Are you a compassionate, organized, and outgoing professional who loves helping people? Do you enjoy building meaningful relationships, solving problems, and making a positive impact in your community?

**Comfort Keepers of Huntington Beach is looking for a Client Care Coordinator to join our team!**

In this rewarding position, you'll help seniors and their families navigate important care decisions, coordinate personalized home care services, and ensure every client receives the attention and support they deserve.

You'll be an important part of our clients' journeys—from their very first phone call to ongoing care and lasting relationships.

**If you're a people person who enjoys variety, takes initiative, and thrives in a relationship-focused environment, we'd love to meet you!**

**What You'll Do**

**Help Families Get Started with Care**

* Respond to inquiries from prospective clients and families.
* Conduct in-home care consultations to understand each client's needs and preferences.
* Explain Comfort Keepers services, care options, and pricing.
* Help families feel confident in their decisions and guide them through the process of starting care.
* Follow up with prospective clients and help turn inquiries into new client relationships.

**Create Personalized Care Experiences**

* Develop and update individualized non-medical care plans.
* Coordinate new client introductions and support smooth transitions into care.
* Work closely with caregivers and office staff to ensure client needs are understood and met.
* Conduct in-home quality assurance visits and client satisfaction check-ins.
* Identify opportunities to improve the quality of care and overall client experience.

**Build Strong Client & Family Relationships**

* Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients and their families.
* Respond to questions, concerns, and changing care needs with empathy and professionalism.
* Help resolve service-related issues and maintain positive client relationships.
* Build trust and connections that encourage long-term client satisfaction and referrals.

**Support Community Relationships**

* Help maintain relationships with local healthcare providers, senior living communities, and other referral partners.
* Occasionally participate in community networking activities and referral partner visits.
* Represent Comfort Keepers with professionalism, warmth, and enthusiasm.

*Community outreach is a smaller part of this position. The primary focus is client care coordination, consultations, and relationship management.*

**What We're Looking For**

**Required Qualifications**

* Excellent communication and customer service skills.
* A friendly, compassionate, and professional personality.
* Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Confidence speaking with families and explaining services.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and solve problems independently.
* Comfortable visiting seniors and families in their homes.
* Basic computer proficiency and willingness to learn home care software.
* Valid driver's license and reliable transportation for local visits.
* Availability for rotating weeknight and weekend on-call responsibilities.

**Preferred Experience**

* 1–2 years of experience in home care, senior care, healthcare administration, client services, or a related field.
* Experience working with seniors and their families.
* Familiarity with care plans, activities of daily living, or dementia care.
* Experience conducting client consultations or assessments.
* Experience with home care management software.

**You'll Be a Great Fit If You...**

* Genuinely enjoy helping people and building relationships.
* Are warm, approachable, and an excellent listener.
* Can confidently guide families through care decisions.
* Are comfortable explaining the value of services and asking prospective clients to move forward.
* Take ownership of problems and follow through until they're resolved.
* Stay organized while juggling multiple responsibilities.
* Enjoy working both independently and as part of a team.
* Believe seniors deserve to live with independence, dignity, and joy.

**Why Work with Comfort Keepers?**

At Comfort Keepers, we believe caregiving is about more than helping with daily tasks. It's about creating meaningful moments, building connections, and helping seniors continue doing the things they love.

Our mission is **Elevating the Human Spirit**, and that commitment extends to our clients, their families, and our team members.

When you join Comfort Keepers, you'll enjoy:

* Competitive compensation based on experience.
* A supportive, collaborative team environment.
* A meaningful career helping seniors and families.
* A variety of responsibilities that keep each day interesting.
* Opportunities to grow your skills in client care and home care operations.
* The satisfaction of knowing your work makes a real difference.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you're compassionate, motivated, and excited about helping seniors live happier, more independent lives, we want to hear from you!

**Apply today to join Comfort Keepers of Huntington Beach and help us Elevate the Human Spirit—one client, one family, and one meaningful connection at a time.**

jobs.title: RETAIL PRODUCTION COORDINATOR
jobs.description:
**JOB SUMMARY:**

The Retail Production Coordinator is responsible for order processing, which involves entering orders into the company's ERP system, procuring the necessary components to fulfill retail orders, collaborating with the AP team, and working with the Retail sales team to ensure prompt and efficient order fulfillment.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES**

In a fast-paced and growing environment like ours, priorities and projects often change so this role includes, but is not limited to, the following responsibilities:

**Order Processing & Procurement**

* Enter purchase orders (POs) and sales orders (SOs) into Microsoft Dynamics Business Central and coordinate purchase order (PO) submission with vendors.
* Maintain and update the Production WIP/tracker with all essential information related to retail purchase orders, and other relevant initiatives.
* Ensure timely and accurate purchase, logging, tracking, and confirmation of order components at the factory level (e.g., hang tags, size strips, price tags).

**Pre-Production & Coordination**

* Collaborate with the Pre-Production Coordinator to confirm accurate factory costs, components, and allocations before order processing.
* Work closely with the Production Manager and Logistics Specialist to oversee the timely delivery of production orders to customers by managing pickups and deliveries domestically and internationally.
* Prepare shipping documentation, including carton labels and packing lists, and coordinate delivery appointments with third-party logistics providers when needed.

**Accounting & Reconciliation**

* Support month-end accounting procedures, including PO receipt processing in the Microsoft Dynamics Business Central clearing maintenance repair and operations (MRO) entries, and transferring blanks scraps to designated locations.
* Work with the Accounting Department to facilitate financial transactions, including delivery notes, credit memos, and vendor payments.

**Process Optimization & Reporting**

* Develop and implement process improvements to enhance efficiency in order processing.
* Ensure accurate documentation and timely submission of shipping records for the Retail Sales team, aiding in invoicing and order fulfillment.

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree (preferred) or equivalent work experience
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience in data entry, purchasing, or supply chain coordination. Must have high level accuracy in data entry.
* **Team Player:** Strong communication and interpersonal skills, fostering effective collaboration across teams. A keen ability to take direction and a commitment to accuracy will help you excel in this role.
* **Critical Problem Solver:** Excellent analytical problem-solving and decision-making abilities.
* **Technical Skills:** Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and Microsoft Dynamics/ Business Central (preferred).
* **Time Management:** Proven ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment with a varied workload.

**Job Title****:** Territory Account Manager (Clinical Outreach)

**Location****:** Long Beach, CA (full-time; onsite)

**Pay****:** $85,000/year + Incentive Bonus Plan

*This posting is an evergreen position, and we are always on the lookout for talented people to join our team. While we may not have a current opening, we are continually building a talent pool of qualified candidates for future opportunities. As our organization grows, we encourage candidates who are passionate about delivering high-quality patient care to express their interest. We value innovation, collaboration, and excellence, and we look forward to connecting with professionals who share our commitment to making a meaningful impact.*

**About Us:**

Founded in 2015, the Food Allergy Institute (FAI) is a cutting-edge research and clinical care center revolutionizing food allergy treatment among the pediatric population. Our Tolerance Induction Program™ is the first of its kind, bringing patients to the point where they can eat whatever they want, whenever they want, without having to worry about any kind of reaction. The success of FAI is built on years of development involving proprietary biomarkers, data analytics and modeling systems which allow unique patient specific therapy to be deployed in the clinic setting and at home safely.

**Why Join FAI?**

The Food Allergy Institute (FAI) is home to innovative thinkers, problem solvers, and passionate leaders who are transforming the world of food allergy treatment. Our work is life-changing for patients and their families, and every member of our team plays a vital role in supporting our mission. With over 180 employees, Our diverse team includes Physicians in the specialties of Pediatrics, Pulmonary, Allergy & Immunology, Emergency Medicine, as well as Nurse Practitioners, Physicians Assistants, and a PhD level research team. In the food allergy world, the growth of FAI is unique in reflecting the effectiveness of its treatment approach and the supportive environment fostered by its team of professionals.

At FAI, you'll be part of a team dedicated to making a real impact. We provide access to cutting-edge technology, offer competitive salaries, comprehensive benefits, and endless opportunities for professional development and career growth. Join us in transforming food allergy care and be inspired to make a difference.

**Who Are We Looking For?**

We are seeking a Territory Account Manager (Clinical Outreach) to build, strengthen, and expand our referral network in the Los Angeles and Orange County areas by cultivating meaningful relationships with physicians, medical practices, and provider groups. As the primary point of contact for referring providers in Southern California, this individual will promote clinical services, facilitate education, and ensure seamless communication between practices and the organization. The Medical Liaison will also collaborate with leadership to identify strategic opportunities, support Affiliate Provider development, and drive community engagement through outreach, clinic tours, and events. By fostering trust and collaboration across the medical community, this role plays a vital part in advancing patient referrals, enhancing provider partnerships, and supporting the organization’s overall growth.

***This is an onsite position that involves travel between different clinic and community locations throughout their assigned region.***

**Key Responsibilities**

* Build and maintain relationships with medical practices, providers, and clinical office staff to strengthen the referral network, including identifying and engaging physicians for advanced training opportunities with our team.
* Cultivate relationships with clinical practices, medical groups, and provider networks, facilitating introductions to leadership and our practice management committee for strategic partnership and growth opportunities.
* Expand the referral funnel by actively engaging community physicians through office visits, clinic tours, and participation in community events.
* Provide physicians with education and resources on anaphylaxis management, clinical programs, and digital patient education tools.
* Identify and recommend physicians for Affiliate Provider opportunities and support leadership in developing these partnerships to advance patient recruitment and clinical billing activities at Affiliate Clinic sites.
* Conduct regular in-person visits and check-ins with physician offices to provide updates, address concerns, and strengthen partnerships.
* Promote the organization’s clinical services, specialties, and programs to community physicians.
* Develop and implement strategies to increase patient referrals and expand market presence.
* Serve as a resource for physicians and office staff, ensuring seamless communication and resolution of issues related to referrals, scheduling, and patient experience.
* Collaborate with internal leadership, marketing, and clinical teams to align outreach efforts with organizational goals.
* Track and report referral patterns, relationship activity, and business development outcomes.
* Stay informed on competitor activity, industry trends, and market opportunities.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Healthcare Administration, or related field (or equivalent experience).
* 2+ years of experience in pharmaceutical sales, physician relations, healthcare business development, or a related healthcare sales role preferred.
* Strong interpersonal, relationship-building, and communication skills.
* Ability to work independently, manage time effectively, and prioritize outreach activities.
* Knowledge of healthcare services, referral processes, and medical practice operations is strongly preferred.
* Proficiency with Google Suite and CRM or referral management software.
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation for travel to physician offices.
* Professional

Fanatics is building a leading global digital sports platform. Critical Loop is shaping the next generation of energy systems by building the integrated edge grid of the future. Specializing in advanced energy management and battery control systems, Critical Loop empowers businesses and communities to seamlessly unite distributed energy resources for faster, more reliable, and affordable grid access. With deep expertise in grid modernization and a passion for creating resilient, responsive energy solutions, Critical Loop drives innovation at the intersection of technology and energy.

**The Role**

We are hiring an Operations & Logistics Coordinator to support the deployment and day-to-day operation of our mobile battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.

This role will own much of the coordination required to move equipment to and from customer sites, manage rental and transportation vendors, maintain accurate site and asset records, support receiving and warehouse activities, and keep operational and maintenance documentation organized.

This is a hands-on, onsite role that combines logistics coordination, operational administration, and practical field support. You will work closely with our Operations Engineers, Projects, Sales, Accounting, and external vendors to make sure equipment, records, and services are where they need to be when they need to be there.

We are looking for someone who is highly organized, follows through reliably, and is comfortable handling both administrative work and practical onsite tasks.

**What You Will Do**

* Coordinate transportation, delivery, retrieval, and staging of batteries, generators, trailers, and other equipment for customer deployments
* Coordinate with rental companies, trucking providers, fuel vendors, and other service providers
* Track equipment rentals, delivery schedules, vendor commitments, and open logistics items
* Support review and reconciliation of rental invoices, fuel deliveries, and other operational costs
* Maintain accurate site, asset, vendor, rental, and operational records in systems such as Salesforce, Odoo, and other internal tools

* Track open issues and follow up with vendors and internal stakeholders until they are resolved

* Support Operations Engineers and project teams with ad hoc logistics and administrative needs
* Occasionally travel locally to vendors, customer sites, DMV offices, or other locations as required

**Must-Haves**

* Experience coordinating construction logistics, equipment rentals, fleet, field service, or similar physical operations
* Strong organization and follow-through across multiple concurrent tasks, vendors, and deadlines
* Comfortable working onsite and performing hands-on tasks including receiving freight, warehouse support, material handling, and local errands
* Clear written and verbal communication with vendors and internal stakeholders

* Experience with Salesforce, Odoo, ERP, CMMS, inventory, fleet-management, or similar systems

jobs.title: Operations Assistant
jobs.description:
The Operations Assistant plays a critical role in maintaining the speed, accuracy, and reliability of day-to-day terminal operations. This position exists to ensure freight flows without disruption, operational data remains accurate in real time, and cross-functional teams are aligned on execution.  
  
In a fast-moving logistics environment, even small delays or communication gaps can create downstream inefficiencies. This role directly mitigates those risks by owning load visibility, coordinating with multiple internal and external stakeholders, and ensuring operational systems reflect ground truth.  
  
Success in this role means shipments move predictably, exceptions are identified and escalated early, and the service center operates with precision, accountability, and minimal rework.

**What you’ll do**
==================

**1. Drive operational coordination and load visibility**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Track outbound loads daily and ensure system updates are accurate and timely
* Proactively communicate delays to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders before 11 AM
* Monitor pickup schedules and investigate loads that have not departed by 10 AM
* Escalate operational risks and delays to Linehaul and leadership with clear context

**2. Execute administrative and documentation workflows**
---------------------------------------------------------

* Manage driver documentation, including IC paperwork, plates, IFTA, and compliance materials
* Collect and route maintenance records to Safety to ensure compliance standards are met
* Manifest inbound and outbound freight, ensuring documentation accuracy across systems
* File and maintain exception reports and operational records

**3. Support delivery execution and customer commitments**
----------------------------------------------------------

* Schedule delivery appointments, including direct deliveries and diverts
* Coordinate redeliveries and obtain ACR (Additional Charge Request) authorization
* Enter ACRs into systems with precision to ensure financial and operational alignment
* Partner with brokers to secure rates for non-service point returns

**4. Resolve operational exceptions and improve throughput**
------------------------------------------------------------

* Trace freight and investigate shipment issues across terminals and agent networks
* Coordinate with internal teams and external partners to resolve delivery disruptions
* Identify recurring issues and escalate patterns that impact service performance
* Support all terminals with system-related and operational inquiries

**5. Maintain operational infrastructure and team efficiency**
--------------------------------------------------------------

* Monitor functionality of printers and administrative equipment within operations
* Provide general administrative support including data entry, filing, imaging, and reporting
* Preset appointments for inbound freight and linehaul contractors
* Contribute to team-based operational goals and continuous improvement efforts

**What you bring**
==================

* High school diploma or GED required; equivalent experience considered
* 1–3 months of relevant administrative or operations experience preferred
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to interact across all levels
* Basic computer proficiency; familiarity with AS/400, Microsoft Office, and imaging tools preferred
* Foundational math skills and comfort working with weights, distances, and monetary values
* Ability to read, interpret, and follow written and verbal instructions
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment
* Capacity to manage multiple tasks simultaneously with attention to detail
* Problem-solving ability in situations with limited standardization
* Hazardous Materials Handling certification preferred
* Experience in transportation, logistics, or terminal operations is a plus

**How you operate**
===================

* You prioritize accuracy without sacrificing speed
* You take ownership of outcomes, not just assigned tasks
* You communicate early, clearly, and with purpose
* You thrive in structured environments but can adapt when conditions shift
* You stay organized and focused under operational pressure
* You collaborate effectively across functions to resolve issues quickly
* You approach problems with practicality and a solution-first mindset

  

**Compensation & Setup**
========================

* **Compensation:** $18.50 per hour
* **Location:** Onsite | Commerce, CA
* **Benefits:** Full benefits package including medical, dental, vision, 401(k), and paid time off

**Physical Demands and Work Environment**
=========================================

The physical demands and work environment described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

**Physical Demands**
--------------------

* Light physical activity performing non-strenuous daily activities of an administrative nature.
* While performing the duties of the job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, walk, reach/handle items, work with fingers, have color vision (ability to identify and distinguish colors) and talk and hear others in conversations via the phone or in person.
* The employee is occasionally asked to stoop, kneel, crouch, crawl, climb or balance and lift objects up to 25 lbs.

**Work Environment**
--------------------

* The noise level is loud based on multiple printers and forklifts running outside of the door.
* Works in well-lighted, heated and/or air-conditioned indoor office setting with adequate ventilation.
* Might be required to occasionally work near toxic or caustic chemicals, moving mechanical parts and/or fumes or airborne particles.

**Social Media Manager & Content Creator, STRIING**

**STRIING** · Los Angeles · Part-time, up to 20 hours/week · Hybrid

**ABOUT STRIING**

STRIING is a newly launched swim brand, being built from the ground up. It is an experience-first bikini bar and workshop where customers build their own set on the spot. You will find STRIING at LA-area markets, collab events, and in a brick and mortar pop-up in Manhattan Beach, CA.

STRIING is part of the Suite Creative Studio portfolio, an LA fashion product development studio specializing in swimwear, intimates, and activewear.

**THE ROLE**

You will own STRIING's social media and content from day one. This is a hands-on role: you plan the calendar, shoot and edit the content, write the captions, engage the community, and report on what works. You report directly to the founder.

This is a rare chance to build a brand's social presence from the ground up. Once performance is proven, the role can expand to other Suite Creative Studio portfolio brands.

**WHO YOU ARE**

This role is perfect for someone who takes initiative, goes the extra mile, and wants to own the results. You are flexible and available to attend brand events as needed, which will include nights and weekends from time to time.

**WHAT YOU WILL DO**

**Strategy and planning**

* Build and run STRIING's monthly content calendar, aligned to drops, markets, pop-ups, collabs, and swim season
* Define and grow STRIING's voice: fun, inclusive, confident, and community-driven
* Set quarterly goals per platform and adjust strategy based on performance

**Content creation**

* Shoot and edit short-form video, photo, and stories for Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest
* Capture the custom bikini bar experience: customers building sets, try-ons, reactions, and finished looks
* Go live from markets and events, and produce recap content after each one
* Create product, styling, fit, and behind-the-scenes content showing how STRIING sets are made
* Design social graphics, carousels, and templates within brand guidelines

**Community and engagement**

* Respond to comments and DMs daily in STRIING's voice; route orders, customer requests, and event inquiries to the right person
* Collect, organize, and repost UGC with permission
* Promote upcoming markets and pop-ups so customers know where to find the bikini bar
* Research competitors
* Stay on top of trending content and algorithm updates for growth and engagment

**Partnerships and events**

* Source and manage creators, ambassadors, and collaborators: outreach, gifting, deliverables, and tracking
* Coordinate content with event hosts and partner brands
* Help plan collab events and in-person activations

**AI-assisted workflow**

* Use AI tools daily to work faster across ideation, scripting, caption drafts, editing, resizing, and repurposing content across platforms
* Use AI for trend research, competitor scans, and turning performance data into clear monthly insights
* Build and maintain reusable prompts, templates, and a STRIING brand voice guide
* Review and refine all AI output so every post is accurate, on-brand, and reads as human

**Analytics and operations**

* Report monthly on reach, engagement, follower growth, and traffic or sales attributed to social and events
* Maintain an organized asset library with clear naming and usage rights
* Support email and website updates with content and copy

**Confidentiality**

* Keep unreleased styles, drops, and collabs confidential until launch; no proprietary Striing or Suite Creative Studio client material is ever posted or uploaded to AI tools

**WHAT YOU BRING**

* 2 to 4 years managing social media for a swimwear, fashion, beauty, or lifestyle brand
* A portfolio of content you shot, edited, and wrote yourself, plus accounts you have grown
* Strong phone-first shooting skills and editing in CapCut, Adobe (Lightroom, Premiere), and Canva, or similar.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools in a content workflow, such as ChatGPT or Claude for ideation and copy, Adobe Firefly or Photoshop generative tools for images, and CapCut or Opus Clip AI features for video
* Good judgment on when AI helps and when content needs a human touch
* Deep fluency in Instagram, TikTok, and Pinterest formats, trends, and analytics
* Comfortable on camera and going live
* Highly organized; comfortable owning a calendar with little oversight
* Flexible to attend brand events, markets, and pop-ups on nights and weekends from time to time
* Must have reliable transportation

**NICE TO HAVE**

* Experience growing a new or early-stage brand
* Experience with influencer programs, paid social, or creator whitelisting
* Experience with Kit, Shopify, or a scheduling tool such as Later or Planoly, ManyChat

**COMPENSATION**

$35 per hour.

Part-time, up to 20 hours per week to start.

Generous STRIING product allowance.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Send your resume, portfolio, and links to at least 2 accounts you have managed to hotline@mystriing.com

The Best Friend's Mission is to do nothing short of making history by bringing about a time when there are No More Homeless Pets. Our goal is that every animal shelter in every community in the country be no kill.

**Skills and Experience:**

  

* **Content Creation, Storytelling & Editing:** 2-4 years shooting and editing both static and video content, with a strong eye for composition, lighting and narrative storytelling. Comfortable with editing tools, and you know how to turn raw footage into something ready to post.

* **Cross-Team Collaboration:** Comfortable working across teams, Programs, National social, local partners, and adjusting as priorities shift.

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**  
The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator, **located at our site in Pomona, California**, is responsible for managing and coordinating the day-to-day operations of clinical research studies, while also providing  
site-level leadership, mentorship, and oversight to the coordinator team. Reporting to the Site Manager, the Lead CRC ensures protocol compliance, data integrity, and inspection readiness, and serves as the primary resource and first point of escalation for the coordinator group.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage clinical research protocols from start-up to close-out.
* Recruit, screen, consent, and enroll eligible participants in compliance with study protocols and ethical guidelines.
* Collect, record, and maintain accurate data and source documentation for each study subject.
* Schedule and conduct study visits and procedures per protocol and ICH-GCP standards.
* Prepare and submit IRB submissions, amendments, continuing reviews, and adverse event reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry into electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors, CROs, monitors, and regulatory bodies.
* Maintain and organize regulatory binders and study documentation in compliance with FDA and GCP requirements.
* Monitor study inventory and order supplies as needed.
* Support audit readiness and participate in monitoring visits, audits, and inspections.
* Educate and communicate with study participants regarding study procedures, risks, and responsibilities.
* Attend study training, site initiation visits (SIVs), and investigator meetings as needed.

**Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary site-level resource and mentor for clinical research coordinators, including onboarding and ongoing training of new staff.
* Oversee distribution of study assignments and monitor team workload, visit coverage, and protocol timelines across coordinators.
* Conduct quality review of case report forms and source documentation completed by other coordinators to support data integrity and inspection readiness.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for protocol questions, monitor findings, and routine sponsor and IRB communications, escalating to the Site Manager as needed.
* Support the Site Manager with operational coordination, scheduling, and site readiness, and provide coverage in the Site Manager's absence where appropriate.
* Maintain site-level training documentation and support team-wide GCP and regulatory compliance.

**Qualifications**  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in health sciences, life sciences, nursing, or related field required.
* Certification as a Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) or equivalent preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in clinical research, preferably in a coordinator role, with demonstrated progression in scope and responsibility.
* Experience with IRB processes, electronic data capture (e.g., REDCap, Medidata), and GCP compliance.
* Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or leading coordinator-level staff strongly preferred.

**Skills:**

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Familiarity with HIPAA and human subject protection regulations.

**Working Conditions:**

* May involve direct patient interaction, phlebotomy, specimen processing, and travel between sites.
* Must be able to work occasional evenings or weekends depending on study requirements.

**Physical Requirements:**

* Ability to stand, walk, sit, use hands, and reach with arms.
* Ability to lift up to 25 pounds occasionally.

**Pay:**

$85-95k, dependent on experience

**Equal Opportunity Employer:**  
ECN Clinical is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the  
basis of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin,  
disability, age, or veteran status.

jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.description:
One Getty Values: Getty is committed to creating a welcoming workplace that reflects the various backgrounds of the communities we serve. We value differences in the pursuit of inquiry and knowledge, mutual understanding, respect, trust, transparency, and cooperation. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship or immigration status, color, disability, ethnicity, familial status, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, national origin, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, veteran status, or any other protected status. Job Summary:

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a highly organized and proactive professional to serve as Executive Assistant to the John E. and Louise Bryson Director of the Getty Conservation Institute. This position oversees day-to-day operations for the director’s office and provides high-level administrative and operational support. The Executive Assistant is key in managing priorities and communications, coordinating activities, and ensuring the efficient functioning of the office in support of the Director’s priorities and the Institute’s mission.

**About Us**

The Getty Conservation Institute is dedicated to finding ways to improve conservation of the world’s cultural heritage—its art objects, museum collections, historic buildings, and archaeological sites and our work often takes place at heritage sites across the globe including locations in South America, Asia, and the Middle East, where we work in partnership with heritage professionals from the region. Our staff have expertise in architecture, archaeology, conservation, engineering, chemistry, materials science, physics, information science, operations management, administration, and communications.

This job will be based in our office at the Getty Center in Los Angeles. It will begin in the office full-time and the opportunity to request a telework schedule may be available after an initial period of training and orientation and will be discussed and approved by your supervisor. Typically, staff with approved telework schedules at the Getty Conservation Institute are in the office more than half of the time.

Major Job Responsibilities:

As the Executive Assistant, you will:

* Proactively manage the director’s attention and focus by anticipating needs, clarifying priorities, and ensuring that the director’s time is directed to the most important issues.
* Manage a complex executive calendar, involving competing requests and multiple scheduling priorities.
* Track inquiries received by the director via email, phone, and mail to ensure timely responses; and maintain director’s database of colleagues’ contact information.
* Coordinate all aspects of the director’s national and international business travel arrangements, which also includes preparation of briefing materials and background information for meetings and trips, and timely completion of expense reports in compliance with Getty policies.
* Maintain the director’s office records in accordance with institutional records management policies. This work regularly involves records of enduring value that document the organization's history and requires preservation of such materials and Getty intellectual property.
* Organize internal and external events of various sizes, which may include venue, catering, technology, and audio-visual arrangements.
* Develop agendas, notes, minutes, and other communications on behalf of the director, including drafting and proofreading correspondence, reports, publications, and presentations, including light editing of images.
* Gather, evaluate, and synthesize information from multiple sources to develop written briefing materials for the director, as requested.
* Process contracts and payments, prepare and track the director’s office budget, procure supplies, implement special projects requested by the director, and perform other duties as assigned.
* Represent the Getty Conservation Institute and the director’s office with professionalism, discretion, and sound judgment in interactions inside and outside Getty.
* Serve as a trusted ambassador who is capable of safeguarding and strengthening key relationships with peers, senior leaders, trustees, donors, and partners.

In all aspects of your responsibilities, you will work under the general direction of the director while exercising independence and sound judgment on the director’s behalf to address complex, sensitive, or ambiguous issues and make decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree and a minimum of 7 years of related experience, including experience providing executive-level support

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

* Ability to thrive and remain composed in a fast-paced work environment.
* Able to recognize when to act independently and when to consult the director.
* Excellent problem-solving, capable of resolving complex issues or identifying well-considered solutions for the director.
* Strategic prioritization and exemplary judgment. Able to understand the office’s priorities and make sound decisions about where the director’s attention is needed.
* Proactive in identifying the director’s needs and external challenges before they become pressing.
* Excellent organizational skills and attention to detail.
* Effective communications skills, both written and verbal; ability to proofread.
* High level of discretion.
* Demonstrated success in planning, organizing and completing projects.
* Self-motivated, able to anticipate emerging tasks.
* Able to balance your own workload between shifting demands and routine office operations.
* Advanced computer skills; able to effectively use technology to access, manage, synthesize, and communicate information. Must be proficient in Microsoft Office applications (including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and OneDrive); familiarity with Blackbaud Raiser’s Edge, and photo editing software

jobs.title: Event Operations Manager
jobs.description:
**About PSQ Productions**

PSQ Productions is an Orange County-based live events, venue operations, and public assembly management company. We produce festivals and community events, promote live music, manage public assembly venues, and provide operational support to sports arenas and event facilities. Our work spans event production, venue management, event operations, guest services, logistics, safety coordination, vendor management, and on-site execution. We are seeking creative trailblazers who embody our core values and are tech-forward, culture-minded, and ready to make a tangible impact on Orange County communities through unforgettable experiences.

**At PSQ Productions, I AM PSQ means every employee represents the people we serve. Our team members help create the experience guests remember, the trust our partners rely on, and the standards our company is known for. We expect every employee to demonstrate PSQ’s core values: Imagination, Adaptability, Mastery, Professionalism, Solutions Oriented, and Quality. These values guide how we serve guests, support teammates, solve problems, and execute events.**

**Summary**

The Operations Manager is responsible for leading the operational execution of assigned events, venues, and projects from planning through load-in, event execution, strike, and post-event closeout.

This role translates event requirements into actionable operational plans, staffing plans, site layouts, equipment and infrastructure needs, timelines, assignments, and procedures. The Operations Manager leads assigned Operations employees and event crews, ensures work is completed safely and on schedule, monitors labor and resources, coordinates vendors and equipment, and maintains accountability for operational standards throughout the event lifecycle.

The Operations Manager is expected to be a hands-on field leader who can identify issues before they impact an event, make sound decisions under pressure, assign resources effectively, and ensure assigned tasks are completed without requiring constant direction from senior leadership.

This role requires strong leadership, accountability, organization, technical event operations knowledge, communication, adaptability, problem-solving, and hands-on experience supporting concerts, festivals, sporting events, community events, venue operations, or other large-scale live events.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

**Event Operations Planning**

* Translate event requirements into comprehensive operational plans covering load-in, setup, event execution, changeovers, strike, and venue reset.
* Develop and maintain event timelines, operational checklists, task assignments, staffing plans, Standard Operating Procedures, and other planning documents required for successful execution.
* Review event requirements, site conditions, client needs, schedules, and production plans to identify operational resources, staffing, equipment, AV, décor, and infrastructure needed for each event.
* Participate in and help lead pre-production meetings, site walks, operational planning meetings, and event briefings.
* Ensure Operations teams, vendors, and stakeholders understand event timelines, responsibilities, access requirements, deadlines, and onsite expectations.
* Review site plans, layouts, floor plans, event maps, and operational drawings and identify potential conflicts involving access, equipment, guest flow, emergency routes, staffing, vendor placement, AV, décor, and operational infrastructure.
* Develop, modify, or support the development of event site plans and operational layouts using CAD or comparable event-design software when required.

**Staffing and Team Leadership**

* Directly supervise assigned Operations employees and event crews, including Supervisors, Leads, Crew Members, and temporary or event-based personnel.
* Develop event-specific Operations staffing plans based on load-in, event, strike, site, equipment, and client requirements.
* Review scheduled labor against operational needs and budget expectations and proactively identify staffing gaps, unnecessary labor, overtime risks, or scheduling concerns.
* Clearly communicate employee assignments, priorities, deadlines, and expectations before and throughout each event.
* Conduct pre-shift briefings, operational check-ins, and post-shift reviews to ensure assignments are understood and completed.
* Monitor performance during events and provide real-time coaching, direction, and corrective guidance when necessary.
* Hold team members accountable for attendance, work quality, deadlines, safety expectations, communication, and completion of assigned responsibilities.
* Confirm completion of assigned work and ensure outstanding or incomplete items are documented and communicated to department leadership.
* Support employee development through coaching, feedback, mentorship, and identification of training needs.
* Escalate employee performance, conduct, attendance, or safety concerns to department leadership and Human Resources as appropriate.
* Monitor Operations labor hours, overtime, meal-period compliance, and schedule adherence and proactively escalate concerns.

**Event Infrastructure and Logistics**

* Coordinate operational vendors, suppliers, equipment, rentals, AV, décor, transportation, site infrastructure, and logistics required to execute assigned events and venue operations.
* Plan and coordinate temporary event infrastructure including generators, temporary power, lighting, barricades, fencing, tents, staging support, back-of-house areas, equipment compounds, pedestrian routes, vehicle access, storage areas, AV needs, décor placement, and other event infrastructure.
* Evaluate operational power, equipment, AV, and site infrastructure requirements in coordination with vendors, production teams, event teams, and venue personnel.
* Ensure infrastructure, equipment, signage, branding, décor, seating, and layouts are placed safely, correctly, and accordin

jobs.title: Business Operations Lead
jobs.description:
Rivian is seeking a Business Operations Lead to serve as the intelligence layer between the Customer Analytics and Sales & Delivery leadership. This role owns the source of truth for all performance KPIs reported by Sales & Delivery — ensuring the data is clean, consistent, and presented in a way that provides actionable insight and drives decision-making.

This is not an analyst role. It is designed for someone who can move fluently between data and narrative, assess performance across site, regional, and portfolio levels simultaneously, and connect macro business trends to the micro-level patterns playing out across individual teams and locations. Success in this role requires strong analytical judgment, a sharp editorial instinct, and the ability to tell a clear story with data to an executive audience.

  

* Maintain the source of truth for all Sales & Delivery performance KPIs — defining metrics, governing definitions, and ensuring consistency across dashboards, reports, and leadership communications
* Serve as the primary liaison to the Customer Analytics organization, translating operational and executive needs into dashboard and reporting requirements and ensuring outputs are clean, accessible, and decision-ready
* Identify performance trends across site, regional, and portfolio levels — connecting macro dynamics to micro-level patterns and surfacing insights before they become compounding problems
* Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations for Sales & Delivery leadership, with diagnosis, root cause, and a suggested path forward
* Own the analytical narrative in executive presentations, briefs, WBRs, QBRs, and leadership reviews — not just the charts, but the story they tell and the decisions they should drive
* Monitor data integrity across all reporting surfaces, identifying inconsistencies, flagging gaps, and driving resolution with the Customer Analytics team to maintain a single version of the truth
* Build and maintain performance visibility frameworks that give site leaders, regional leaders, and executives the right level of insight for their scope of accountability
* Partner with Analytics, Finance, Sales Operations, and Field Leadership to align on KPI definitions, ensure consistent application across the organization, and evolve the metrics framework as the business scales

  

* 6+ years in retail analytics, sales analytics, commercial performance insights, or a similarly data-intensive commercial role
* Experience in automotive, retail, or other consumer-facing commercial operations preferred
* Experience owning KPI frameworks and governing metric definitions across complex, multi-stakeholder organizations
* Demonstrated ability to assess performance at site, regional, and portfolio levels — and connect macro trends to micro-level outcomes across a distributed organization
* Fluency in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Hex, or similar, with experience shaping dashboard design and working directly with analytics or data engineering teams
* Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM operations and analytics tooling preferred
* Proven ability to translate business questions into analytical requirements and analytical findings back into business language
* Strong narrative instincts: you don't just surface data, you build the story behind it clearly enough that executives can act on it
* Exceptional written communication and presentation skills — you build executive-ready materials that are clear, well-structured, and decision-oriented

jobs.title: Lead Clinical Research Coordinator
jobs.description:
**Position Summary:**  
The Lead Clinical Research Coordinator (Lead CRC), **located at our site in Huntington Beach, CA**, is responsible for managing and coordinating the day-to-day operations of clinical research studies, while also providing site-level leadership, mentorship, and oversight to the coordinator team. Reporting to the Site Manager, the Lead CRC ensures protocol compliance, data integrity, and inspection readiness, and serves as the primary resource and first point of escalation for the coordinator group.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Coordinate and manage clinical research protocols from start-up to close-out.
* Recruit, screen, consent, and enroll eligible participants in compliance with study protocols and ethical guidelines.
* Collect, record, and maintain accurate data and source documentation for each study subject.
* Schedule and conduct study visits and procedures per protocol and ICH-GCP standards.
* Prepare and submit IRB submissions, amendments, continuing reviews, and adverse event reports.
* Ensure timely and accurate data entry into electronic data capture (EDC) systems.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for sponsors, CROs, monitors, and regulatory bodies.
* Maintain and organize regulatory binders and study documentation in compliance with FDA and GCP requirements.
* Monitor study inventory and order supplies as needed.
* Support audit readiness and participate in monitoring visits, audits, and inspections.
* Educate and communicate with study participants regarding study procedures, risks, and responsibilities.
* Attend study training, site initiation visits (SIVs), and investigator meetings as needed.

**Leadership Responsibilities:**

* Serve as the primary site-level resource and mentor for clinical research coordinators, including onboarding and ongoing training of new staff.
* Oversee distribution of study assignments and monitor team workload, visit coverage, and protocol timelines across coordinators.
* Conduct quality review of case report forms and source documentation completed by other coordinators to support data integrity and inspection readiness.
* Serve as the first point of escalation for protocol questions, monitor findings, and routine sponsor and IRB communications, escalating to the Site Manager as needed.
* Support the Site Manager with operational coordination, scheduling, and site readiness, and provide coverage in the Site Manager's absence where appropriate.
* Maintain site-level training documentation and support team-wide GCP and regulatory compliance.

**Qualifications:**  
**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in health sciences, life sciences, nursing, or related field required.
* Certification as a Clinical Research Coordinator (CCRC) or equivalent preferred.

**Experience:**

* Minimum 3-4 years of experience in clinical research, preferably in a coordinator role, with demonstrated progression in scope and responsibility.

* Prior experience mentoring, coaching, or leading coordinator-level staff strongly preferred.

* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and meet deadlines.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Word, Excel, Outlook).
* Familiarity with HIPAA and human subject protection regulations.

**Job Description**

**CUSTOMS AND LOGISTICS COORDINATOR**

**Summary:** Customs and Logistics Coordinator provides support to imports/exports Customs clearance and compliance, domestic/international freight bookings and third-party warehouse day-to-day operations. This role requires familiarity with national and international trade regulations, as well as the ability to successfully categorize and classify shipments based on a complex tariff coding system.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

Customs and Logistics Coordinator is responsible for the following activities:

* Coordinate paperwork flow between Company and Customs brokers.
* Prepare and file Customs Forms as needed.
* Work with Customs brokers on classifying and assigning HST# to new products.
* Maintaining HST# updated in the system.
* Assure compliance with Customs regulations.
* Handling Customs inquiries and audits.
* Coordinate transportation providers to ensure prompt and proper movement of shipments.
* Review purchase orders/invoices and shipping documents to ensure accuracy.
* Make special shipping arrangements as necessary.
* Track and fix shipping errors.
* Maintain relationship with third-party warehouse.
* Organize daily domestic/international shipment plans.
* Manage day-to-day operations and flows with third-party warehouse (items, EAN codes, serial #, picking lists, picking lists confirmations, packing lists, tracking# confirmations, etc.).
* Monitor KPIs.
* Define and manage freight and warehousing budgets.
* Ensure that the quality of all services provided meets the required standard.
* Develop processes that make the supply chain more efficient and organized.

**Requirements:**

Customs and Logistics Coordinator uses a variety of soft skills and industry knowledge of best practices to maintain and improve the stages of the supply chain. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skill, and/or ability required:

* Strong working knowledge of US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) requirements.
* Experience with US ACE interface.
* Understanding of 19 CFR (Parts 1 – 199) and the US HTS.
* Knowledge of Canadian customs import regulations.
* Effective communication, including writing, speaking and interpersonal communication.
* Quick critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Excellent customer service and client relations skills.
* Keep organization and time management skills.
* Good collaboration and teamwork abilities.
* Great leadership and goal-setting skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment.
* Advanced data analysis and data visualization.
* Expert inventory management.
* Ability to use computers, software and other technology for inventory and communication purposes.
* Understanding of the supply chain, including common obstacles and effective solutions.
* International and national trade-related knowledge.

**Education:**

Associate or a bachelor’s degree in a related field, such as business, supply chain management or a related field.

**Language Ability:**

Ability to read, analyze, and interpret general business periodicals, professional journals, technical procedures, or governmental regulations. Ability to write reports, business correspondence, and procedure manuals. Ability to effectively present information and respond to questions from groups of managers, clients, customers, and the general public.

* Support the implementation of new processes, tools, and operational improvements.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to drive adoption of new workflows and scalable solutions.
* Apply analytical thinking to improve existing business processes and reduce manual effort.

The role offers a unique blend of **financial analytics, strategic stakeholder engagement, and emerging AI technologies**, making it an excellent opportunity for professionals who enjoy working with data while driving meaningful operational improvements.

**Pay Rate:** $60 - $65 per hour.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* 5+ years of hands-on experience in spend tracking, budgeting, forecasting, and capacity or resource analysis.
* Practical experience with prompt engineering, AI agent development, or workflow automation to improve business processes.
* Advanced spreadsheet skills, including complex formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and large-workbook modeling.
* Experience analyzing financial data, identifying spend and forecast variances, and developing actionable recommendations.
* Experience building dashboards and data visualizations using Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or equivalent BI tools.
* Demonstrated ability to create and present financial reports and insights to directors and senior leadership, including non-finance stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to explain financial findings clearly and concisely.
* Ability to work autonomously in ambiguous environments, manage competing priorities, meet deadlines, and proactively follow up on outstanding actions.
* Ability to handle confidential budget, vendor, and headcount information with discretion.

**Preferred Qualifications and Skills**

* Experience supporting engineering, hardware, R&D, manufacturing, or consumer electronics organizations.
* Experience with New Product Introduction (NPI) processes and product development lifecycle milestones.
* Previous experience at major technology or product companies such as Apple, Google, or Microsoft.
* Experience implementing process improvements, change management initiatives, and new business workflows.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
* Relevant professional experience or certifications in data analytics, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, SQL, or cloud-based data analytics.

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, Business Analytics, Data Science, Statistics, or a related quantitative field is preferred but not required. Equivalent relevant professional experience may be considered.

**Company Description**

Every day, we challenge ourselves to be considerate, fair and to re-think what great outcomes mean for our customers. This permeates down to how we approach every interaction, on every project, for every client. You'll thrive here if you are a dynamic self-starter, a difference-maker or someone who wants to deliver great results, without constraints.

The itD Digital Experience: Joining us means you'll be part of our global community, you have a say about your own career journey, and you'll get a chance to give back to causes that matter. You will experience working with Fortune 500 companies and high-performance teams across numerous industries. itD offers our employees excellent benefits such as medical, dental, vision, life insurance, paid holidays, 401K + matching, networking & career learning and development programs. We are growing and we want to see you grow! Visit https://itdtech.com/careers to learn more about what working at itD can mean for you.

jobs.title: Bilingual Program Coordinator Direct Service
jobs.description:
**Are you a skilled professional who believes in lending your skills to end hunger during these unprecedented times? If so, consider being the** **Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service** **for the San Francisco-Marin Food Bank.** Join our friendly, collaborative, and hardworking programs team, reporting to the Program Supervisor.

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Service is responsible for providing onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets. This is a fixed term position anticipated to end June 30, 2028.

Who We Are:

**Our mission** is to end hunger in San Francisco and Marin.

**We envision** a just and equitable society that nurtures a resilient community. We envision a community where everyone will have access to nutritious food of their choosing and will be uplifted by a network of support. We work with our community to create lasting solutions to address both the hunger we see today and the root causes that perpetuate food insecurity in our society. Every week, over 50,000 households count on us for food assistance. 60% of what we distribute is fresh fruits and vegetables.

Who You Are:

To excel in this position, you will need to approach the work with the following habits and values:

* **Collaboration and Teamwork:** Partners with others to get work done. Gains trust and support of others. Does own fair share of the work. Seeks assistance from other team members, as needed. Volunteers assistance and undertakes additional tasks to support others. Acknowledges colleagues accomplishments and shares credit on collaborative work.
* **Values Differences/Embraces Inclusion and Diversity:** Seeks to understand different perspectives and cultures. Contributes to a work climate where differences are valued and supported and want to do their best. Self-aware and considerate of how bias, poor treatment and conflict is handled and demonstrates valuing others. Is sensitive to cultural norms, expectations and ways of communicating.
* **Customer Focus/Service Orientation:** Collaborates with colleagues to deliver high-quality service. Actively listens and asks questions to determine participant/volunteer needs. Suggests ways to improve the participant experience. Demonstrates values of caring, respect, honesty, and responsibility in all interacting with staff, volunteers, and participants. Establishes and maintains effective participant/volunteer relationships.
* **Judgement:** Considers the long-term as well as immediate short-term outcomes and actions. Recognizes when to escalate appropriate of specific situations to the next higher level of expertise. Considers alternative available actions, resources, and constraints before selecting a method for accomplishing a task or project. Confirms details before deciding how to act. Seeks out others to check or review their own work for accuracy and completeness. Reviews all relevant information or aspects of a situation before acting or deciding.
* **Self-Awareness and Professionalism:** Reflects on activities and impact on others. Proactively seeks feedback without being defensive. Is open to criticism and talking about shortcomings. Admits mistakes and gains insight from experiences. Is conscious of an manages how ones actions and reactions impact others. Knows strengths, weaknesses, opportunities and limits. Knows how to conduct self in the workplace: communicates effectively, resolves conflict, does not gossip, acts with integrity, and holds professional boundaries.
* **Delivers Commitments:** Follows through on commitments. Acts with a clear sense of ownership. Takes personal responsibility for decisions, actions and failures. Are seen as direct and truthful. Solves issues, rather than focusing on blame. Identifies and communicates what they need of others, and shares that with them directly and professionally.

What You Would Be Accountable for:

The Bilingual Program Coordinator, Direct Services will be responsible for the following key pieces of work:

* Program implementation: site set up, product receipt, operation, safety and clean-up.
* Volunteer management: train, assign roles and ensure best practices are being followed.
* Site environment: distributions are welcoming and provide a positive experience for everyone.
* Participant support: effectively communicate information and use technology to streamline and track program implementation.

What You Would Be Doing Right Now:

* Provide onsite support at our staff-led Community Markets: volunteer management, grocery distribution, choice management, participant support, and support the co-location with support services.
* Ensure food availability at community markets through food 'ordering', inventory management, and assessment of product movement
* Complete administrative responsibilities, including communicating pertinent information to team members, creating market signage, developing participant written communications, reporting attendance and food inventory, and communicating with participants via ZenDesk.
* Maintain required job knowledge, skills and core competencies. Attend and engage in required trainings and team meetings.
* Represent the Food Bank in the community by engaging with participants, volunteers, partners, and community members.
* Assist in resolving complex and sensitive customer service issues, either in person, by phone, or in writing; maintain records/documentation of customer service issues and/or involve leadership to ensure appropriate resolution
* Support other programs with direct service and/or administrative responsibilities, as needed.
* Ability to work some evenings and weekends
* Perform other duties, as assigned.

What Else You Should Know:

**All internal candidates must apply using their Food Bank work email within 10 business days of posting to be considered. Applications submitted after 10 days are still welcome but may not be reviewed or afforded an interview, depending on the status of the selection process.**
