Agentio enables marketers to buy creator-led ads as easily and scalably as Meta or Google ads—automating sourcing, pricing, contracting, delivery, and measurement—so work that took months now happens in minutes.

We’re on a mission to transform a $800B digital ad ecosystem by shifting digital ad spend into the hands of creators. That means better outcomes for marketers and enabling creators to live off their work—finally being paid in proportion to the value they create. That shift is accelerating: Unilever’s CEO has said the company will move roughly half of its ad budget into social and creators—Unilever is among the world’s largest advertisers, spending around $9–10B annually. As these dollars move, they need performance-grade pipes; Agentio is how those dollars flow to creators with the speed, control, and measurement marketers expect. We enable brands like Uber, DoorDash, and Bombas to run creator campaigns with the same rigor, control, and accountability as their core performance channels.

Our AI-Native platform enables real-time content understanding at scale, simultaneous reasoning across hundreds of thousands of pieces of content, and intelligent allocation of multi-million dollar budgets. Our models apply more cross-platform performance signal than anyone else in the world, compounding with every campaign through a high-trust marketplace with accelerating network effects. The result is a flywheel: brands get the performance they’ve been chasing, creators get the intelligence and income they deserve, and Agentio becomes the infrastructure powering a generational shift in where media dollars flow.

The market agrees. Agentio has raised $56M at a $340M valuation, including a Series B led by Forerunner that followed our Series A within a calendar year. Backed by Benchmark, Craft, and AlleyCorp. Named to Forbes’ Next Billion Dollar Startups, 2025. Named to Inc.’s Best Places to Work 2026, one of 10 companies nationally recognized in the “On the Rise: 0–4 Years in Business” category.

An $800B market. A once-in-a-generation technology shift. This is the moment. This is the team. Come build something generational with us.

**About the Role**

You’ll start out reporting directly to our CEO, working alongside our sales leaders, with broader scope as the team grows. This is a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

Our CEO and sales leaders are out in the market constantly: at conferences, on customer and investor trips, in rooms full of potential clients we want to meet with. The relationships they start there are some of the best pipeline we have. But leaders get busy, and we need to build a more systematic way of providing leverage to our CEO and GTM leadership.

This is different from a traditional SDR seat. You aren’t working a queue of leads. Your work follows our leaders: where they’re going, who they met, and what’s next. That means the work is less structured, moves faster, and needs real judgment. You’ll write in their voice, manage their threads, and represent them to senior buyers.

You’ll work directly with our CEO and GTM leaders, report into a sales leader, and eventually partner with our SDR Manager as the team grows. It’s a rare chance to learn how the best people in a fast-growing company think about winning deals, with a clear path into a seller or broader GTM role.

**What You’ll Do**

* Take over the outbound inboxes and LinkedIn profiles of our CEO and sales leaders, and run outreach on their behalf in their voice
* After events: build the follow-up list, draft personalized outreach, and run sequences quickly so every conversation gets continued
* Before trips: use Sales Navigator and HubSpot to find our target prospects in each city, then book meetings so leaders’ calendars are full when they land
* Build AI-powered workflows for account research, trigger spotting, drafting, and follow-up, and keep improving them
* Manage replies, handoffs, and scheduling so no warm conversation goes cold
* Work with leaders to plan ahead: know their travel and event calendar, and set targets for each one
* Keep HubSpot clean, and report on what’s working and what isn’t

**Key Metrics You’ll Own**

* Meetings booked for leaders ahead of trips and events
* Share of event contacts followed up with, and how quickly
* Reply and positive response rates
* Pipeline sourced and influenced by leadership outreach
* Quality of accounts and contacts reached

**What You Need**

* 1-3 years of experience in sales development, BDR work, or a similar outbound role where you owned outreach and pipeline; or 1-2 years in a sales or trading role at a leading investment bank
* Demonstrated experience using AI to work faster and smarter (we’ll ask you to show us what you’ve built or how you use it day to day)
* Excellent writing: clear, concise, and able to capture someone else’s voice
* Strong judgment and discretion, because you’ll have access to senior leaders’ inboxes and relationships
* Highly organized, with the discipline to keep dozens of threads moving at once
* Strong data literacy: you know which numbers matter and can work with AI to get to the answer
* 4-year degree from a leading university

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with Sales Navigator and HubSpot
* Experience at an early-stage or high-growth startup
* Experience selling into brands, agencies, or the ad tech and media ecosystem
* Experience supporting executives or founders, or running outbound on their behalf

**About You**

* You’re AI-native in how you work: you reach for AI first, and you’re not waiting for permission or a playbook
* You’re a builder who would rather create the system than follow one
* You’re comfortable working directly with executives and holding your own
* You’re fast and follow through: when an event ends, you’re already moving
* Nimble, hungry, humble, and adaptiv

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Overview:

As a site based **Project Coordinator** at Linesight, you will work with highly experienced, culturally diverse, and passionate teams nurturing a strong social dynamic and a shared sense of achievement. You will gain vast industry experience that will open doors for you, extend your skillset and expand your perspective. We will empower, support, and enable you to take real responsibility in your role so that you can take charge of your career progression with us. For us lasting trusted relationships are everything, both with our teams and our clients.

The Opportunity:

**In this role you will:**

* Consolidate team action items and track their completion
* Partner with other project coordinators on standardization of reporting and lessons learned
* Create templates which allow partners to understand and apply the data analysis results
* Ensure documentation is well organised and accessible
* Manage annual contract extension matrix ensuring amendments are completed on time
* Develop dashboards for ongoing operations and reporting, including creating a live reporting tool for real time progress reporting, trending, data validation & regional communications
* Prepare reports for executive leadership that communicate trends, patterns and predictions using program data
* Ensure imported data is accurate, working with partners to validate and update if necessary
* Support development and updates of monthly reporting
* Support vendor program, including pipeline, contracts, and onboarding

**We would love to hear from you if you:**

* Have experience in data analysis for a large project
* Enjoy collecting and interpreting data, analysing results & creating automated reports for stakeholder review
* Have experience using statistical tools to interpret data sets, paying particular attention to trends and patterns that could be valuable for diagnostic and predictive analytics
* Have worked closely with stakeholders in gathering requirements, performing analysis and delivering complex analysis to support strategic business decisions.

All interviews are conducted either in person or virtually with video required.

This is a full-time, on-site role on a project based in Atlanta GA.

About us:

Linesight is a highly successful global project and cost management consultancy that keeps clients coming back. And for that we have our people to thank. You see we’re not like the others. We’re different. Unique. It’s our fresh thinking and focus on what matters that has led to our evolving. We are on a journey working in some of the most exciting innovative sectors with some of the world’s most prestigious companies delivering major projects that deliver a more sustainable built environment. We have an open culture and a flat structure where you can expect to be treated with genuine care, respect, and empathy. With Linesight, you can truly discover the power of team!

Diversity, inclusion and accessibility

Linesight is committed to transparent, equal opportunity employment practices. We are building a diverse and inclusive organisation, accessible to all, based on having a safe culture which enables all our people to be their true selves. We are a people business, and we understand that the more inclusive we are, the happier our people and better our work will be. jobs.title: Retail Program Specialist I
jobs.description:
Yamaha is seeking to fill a Retail Program Specialist I for its facility in Marietta, GA. The ideal candidate will provide customer service and program administration support to the Dealer Network and Field Sales team through the Retail Operations phone queue and email inboxes. Administers retail incentive and BLU Print Dealer Performance programs from setup through payout, including inquiry resolution, payment funding, reporting, appeals, and record retention.

**What you'll be doing:**

* Serve as a primary representative for Dealer Retail Incentives, providing daily phone and email support to dealers, Field Sales, and internal stakeholders regarding program requirements, eligibility, points, payments, and discrepancies.
* Administer assigned Dealer Incentive and BLU Print programs, including accurate setup, verification, maintenance, processing, and payment administration in SAP Vistex, YDS, and other applicable systems.
* Research and resolve dealer inquiries and discrepancies by reviewing program guidelines and supporting records, coordinating with internal partners as needed, and clearly communicating outcomes and required follow-up.
* Provide program summary and detail reporting to management, field staff and internal support groups.
* Conduct audits of dealer marketing requirements that support BLU Print eligibility and point accumulation. Review and validate YDDI submissions in YDS, communicate approval status or required corrections to dealers, monitor resubmissions for compliance, maintain supporting documentation, and report results to BLU Print management and the Dealer Network team.
* Coordinate quarterly BLU Print appeals by tracking cases in Smartsheet, researching supporting evidence, preparing and presenting appeal packets, obtaining required signatures, and retaining final records in Smartsheet, SmartVault, and other approved systems.
* Maintain records of customer support provided to the Dealer network and Field Sales team through the phone queues and emails utilizing the Customer Relationship Management system (Siebel). Ensure that inquiries, research, follow up commitments, and resolutions are appropriately documented to support accurate service requests.
* Act as a liaison with internal departments and outside vendors to resolve program or system issues, maintain audit-ready records, and support consistent execution of dealer retail programs.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**What you need to be successful:**

* High School education or higher.
* 2-3 years of dealer support, customer service, program administration, retail incentives, sales operations, or related experience.
* Experience working in a customer-facing, dealer support, call center, or program administration environment preferred.
* Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office including Excel.
* SAP/Vistex preferred.

**Decision-Making Responsibility**

* Job requires judgment, initiative, and attention to detail within approved policies, procedures, and program guidelines.
* Works under general supervision to research dealer questions, reconcile information, resolve routine discrepancies, and prioritize work based on dealer impact, payment timing, and program deadlines.
* Escalates policy interpretations, material payment concerns, control exceptions, and appeal decisions as appropriate.

Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and underrepresented minorities are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Yamaha, we understand that talent comes in various forms, as such we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive, and authentic workplace. If you're excited about this role but your experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles!

**What's in it for you:**

* 401(k) and Profit Sharing
* Fertility Benefits
* 37.5 hour work-week
* Medical, Dental, Vision
* Life and AD&D Insurance
* Wellness Program
* Short-Term Disability Coverage (for hourly roles)
* Long-Term Disability
* Student Debt Repayment Benefits
* Ability to borrow Yamaha product

**Reports to:** Dealer Incentives Manager I

Yamaha Motor Corporation, USA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identify, national origin, veteran or disability or any other status protected by federal, state, or local law. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

jobs.description:
**Security Sales Representative**

**Department:** Sales/Business Development  
**Reports To:** Director of Business Development  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Hybrid – Atlanta, Georgia

**About PM Security Solutions**

PM Security Solutions is a rapidly growing security and traffic control provider serving commercial properties, multifamily communities, construction sites, retail environments, special events, and private clients throughout the Atlanta metro area. Our organization is built on professionalism, responsiveness, accountability, and operational excellence. We pride ourselves on delivering customized security solutions that protect people, property, and business operations.

We are seeking a highly motivated Security Sales Representative who thrives in relationship-driven environments and is passionate about helping clients solve operational and security challenges through proactive service solutions.

**Position Summary**

The Security Sales Representative is responsible for driving revenue growth through strategic business development, relationship management, and consultative sales within the company’s security services division. This role will focus heavily on developing new business opportunities while maintaining and expanding existing client relationships across multiple industries.

This individual will act as a trusted advisor to prospective and current clients by assessing risk exposure, identifying operational vulnerabilities, and recommending tailored security solutions that align with client goals and budgets.

The ideal candidate is energetic, polished, self-driven, and capable of building strong professional relationships with property managers, executives, developers, event coordinators, construction leaders, and community associations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Prospect, identify, and secure new business opportunities throughout the Atlanta market
* Generate qualified leads through networking, cold outreach, referrals, community involvement, and strategic partnerships
* Build and maintain relationships with:
  + Commercial real estate groups
  + Multifamily and HOA communities
  + Construction companies
  + Retail centers
  + Hospitality clients
  + Industrial facilities
  + Event organizers
  + Property management firms
* Conduct on-site meetings, risk assessments, presentations, and walkthroughs with prospective clients
* Develop customized security proposals and service recommendations based on client operational needs and risk profiles
* Present and negotiate contracts, pricing, and service agreements
* Consistently meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales goals

**Security Solution Consulting**

* Understand and effectively present company service offerings, including:
  + Armed Security Officers
  + Unarmed Security Officers
  + Mobile Patrol Services
  + Off-Duty Police Services
  + Event Security
  + Traffic Control & Permitting Support
  + Fire Watch Services
  + Access Control & Site Monitoring
* Evaluate client concerns related to safety, liability exposure, staffing gaps, crowd management, access control, and property protection
* Collaborate closely with operations leadership to ensure solutions are operationally sound and scalable
* Assist clients in developing proactive security strategies and service plans

**Client Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned and newly acquired accounts
* Maintain ongoing communication to ensure high levels of client satisfaction and retention
* Conduct periodic account reviews and quality assurance check-ins
* Identify opportunities for service expansion, upselling, and renewals
* Address client concerns professionally and coordinate with operations teams to resolve issues promptly
* Support onboarding and implementation efforts for new contracts

**Pipeline Management & Reporting**

* Maintain accurate records of all prospecting activity, meetings, proposals, and sales opportunities within CRM systems
* Track pipeline metrics, conversion rates, and sales performance KPIs
* Provide regular sales forecasts and activity reports to leadership
* Participate in weekly sales and operational meetings
* Maintain strong follow-up discipline and consistent communication cadence

**Brand Representation & Market Presence**

* Represent PM Security Solutions professionally at networking events, trade associations, community meetings, and industry functions
* Develop market awareness around company capabilities and differentiators
* Stay informed on industry trends, local crime trends, operational risks, and competitive market conditions
* Assist with strategic marketing initiatives and community outreach efforts when needed

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 2–5 years of outside sales, business development, or account management experience required
* Security industry, staffing, facilities management, law enforcement, construction, or service-industry sales experience strongly preferred
* Demonstrated ability to generate leads and close recurring service contracts
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills
* Highly organized with excellent time-management and follow-up abilities
* Comfortable conducting in-person meetings, networking, and site visits
* Ability to work independently while collaborating cross-functionally with operations leadership
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office, CRM platforms, and proposal development
* Valid driver’s license and reliable transportation required

The Account Manager is responsible for maintaining and growing long-term relationships with enterprise healthcare clients and partners, identifying new revenue opportunities, retaining existing relationships, and increasing engagement with key stakeholders. The Account Manager fulfills these objectives by combining communication, commercial acumen, consultative selling, and relationship management skills.

The Account Manager proactively builds relationships and influence across operational decisionmakers and executive leadership and is accountable for achieving assigned revenue growth and retention objectives.

TrustCommerce, founded in 1999, is now a part of RevSpring Inc.

* Proactively monitors relationship health and retention risks and leads periodic client business reviews with cadence tailored to account size, complexity, and needs.
* Manages contractual obligations and advocates for assigned accounts and the company. Leads contract renewals and commercial negotiations in collaboration with leadership, Legal, and Finance. Reviews invoices for accuracy and assists with outstanding payments as needed.
* Presents relevant new products, services, enhancements, and partnerships to clients. Establishes and maintains positive rapport with an assigned group of existing clients and gathering knowledge of each client’s business priorities, products, services, and methods of accepting payments to foster solid, productive relationships.

* Proactively builds relationships and influence with operational decisionmakers through executive leadership across the Revenue Cycle, Treasury/Finance, and IT organizations.

* Develops and maintains a strategic account plan for every assigned account, documenting key stakeholders, client priorities, retention risks, and growth opportunities.
* Maintains comprehensive knowledge of TrustCommerce products and services and changes within the payment processing industry; develops working awareness of company’s solutions to recognize opportunities and engage appropriate specialists.
* Accountable for achieving assigned revenue growth and retention objectives and maintaining accurate opportunity information and forecasts in Salesforce.

  
  

**Minimum Requirements:**

**Specific Job Skills:**

* Must thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic, and diverse environment.
* Excellent written, presentation and verbal communication skills.
* Detail-oriented team player with excellent interpersonal skills, good organizational, planning, presentation, and problem-solving skills.

jobs.description:
Come join our team!

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry. Fueled and driven by capable, committed people who share common beliefs and values and "bring it" every day, EPIC is always looking for people who have "the right stuff" – people who know what they want and aren't afraid to make it happen.

Headquartered in New York City and founded in 2007, our company has over 4,000 employees nationwide. With locations spread out across the U.S., our local market knowledge and industry expertise helps support our clients' regional and global needs. We have grown very quickly since our founding, and we continue to see growth and success thanks to our hard-working and growth-minded employees.

Our core values are: Owner mindset, Inspire trust, Think big, and Drive results. If these values and growth align with what you're looking for in your next career? Then consider joining our amazing team!

  

**JOB OVERVIEW:**

Within our Construction & Design vertical, we have a team that specializes in providing insurance brokerage and risk consulting services for construction and design professionals, specifically large accounts for architect & engineering firms (A/E). What differentiates us is our construction industry expertise. Our leaders have prior experience as practicing construction lawyers (in-house and outside), engineers, consultants, and underwriters – giving us a unique and unmatched insight into how A/E firms operate, deliver projects, and manage risks. With respect to insurance, we place many of our largest clients who qualify in highly profitable group captive programs that have saved millions, and we do so for more A/E firms than all other insurance brokers combined.

We've been so successful, that now we're looking to grow our team!

The **Account Manager - Project Solutions** will be the primary client contact and will be expected to actively cultivate, improve and cement positive client relationships and use appropriate company resources in performing these functions. While the Account Manager will work with new clients produced by others, the Account Manager will not be expected to develop new business. The Account Manager's main function is to: provide day-to-day client service, manage the renewal process for existing clients, and manage the intake and establishment of new clients.

  

**LOCATION:** Hybrid required, 3 days a week in-office - in Alpharetta GA, Chicago IL, or St. Louis MO.

  

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**

* Candidates with strong, professional communication skills – both written and verbal. Ideal candidates can successfully pivot between providing detailed and accurate written communication, as well as picking up the phone and having a detailed verbal conversation with clients or internal stakeholders.
* High attention to detail, and the ability to learn and understand software systems quickly.
* **REQUIRED: At least 5+ years** of experience working for an insurance agency, broker or carrier, **AND experience working with Controlled Insurance Programs (OCIPs, CCIPs) and Builder's Risk**
* Candidates who adapt well to priority changes, deadlines, and who love problem solving and coming up with solutions and answers to client questions.

  

**WHAT YOU'LL DO:**

A detailed list of job duties includes (but is not limited to):

Critical Job Functions:  
The account manager will handle day-to-day client issues and questions, including but not limited to:  

* Answer client questions and resolve client problems
* Process and follow up on cancellation notices by insurers to ensure accurate and timely resolution
* Appropriately document customer service transactions
* Handle changes in exposure and manage related endorsement and documentation process
* Forward contract reviews to appropriate resources
* Forward certificate of insurance requests to appropriate resource
* Issue Auto ID Cards as needed
* Create and update account information in the shared database
* Claims reporting
* Assist with processing of invoicing and order financing when appropriate

Proactively manage the insurance renewal and new business process in accordance with EPIC's timing standards.  

* Pre‐complete insurance applications
* Send request for information to clients
* Follow‐up on collecting information
* Submit information to insurers
* Negotiate policy terms
* Obtain options from competing insurers as needed
* Prepare insurance proposal including analysis and comparison of options (if applicable)
* and present to client (mostly via phone or web)
* Prepare documentation including invoicing and confirmation of coverage
* Review and email policies to clients
* Use agency management system (Sagitta) as appropriate throughout the process

Job Accountability Measures:  

* Customer satisfaction; retention
* Adherence to established procedures
* Timing and quality of service
* Technical accuracy; attention to detail
* Positive professional attitude; leadership
* Proactive problem‐solving
* Effective communication
* Personal development
* Avoidance of errors and omissions
* Meet or exceed agreed‐upon goals

  

**WHAT YOU'LL BRING:**

jobs.title: Strategic Account Manager
jobs.description:
**Strategic Accounts Manager**

Join us at Pratt Industries and play a pivotal role in our mission to lead in sustainable packaging solutions. As a Strategic Accounts Manager (SAM), your efforts will directly contribute to our commitment to sustainability and community impact, making you an essential part of our success in revolutionizing the packaging industry with 100% recycled products.

The SAM is responsible for prospecting, retaining, and growing strategic accounts. This role develops multiyear account strategies, builds relationships across customer organizations, identifies new revenue opportunities, and coordinates Pratt Industries' design, manufacturing, operational, and commercial resources to deliver differentiated packaging solutions. Success requires strong business acumen, executive-level relationship management, disciplined opportunity development, and the ability to lead complex initiatives across multiple facilities and functions.

**Discover the Core of Our Team**

Our team thrives on the synergy of entrepreneurial spirit, growth-oriented leadership, and a collaborative culture. Here, new ideas are welcomed, development is a cornerstone, and working towards common goals signifies progress. It's not just about packaged products; it's about unboxing your best life with a career that supports and evolves with you.

**What You'll Give**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans, including growth targets, opportunity pipelines, stakeholder maps, and competitive strategies.
* Own revenue, retention, and business share objectives for assigned accounts.
* Lead commercial negotiations, pricing strategies, contract development, renewals, and RFP responses.
* Build relationships across procurement, operations, supply chain, sustainability, engineering, marketing, and executive leadership.
* Coordinate cross-functional teams across design, manufacturing, customer service, finance, logistics, and operations.
* Conduct regular business reviews and communicate performance, opportunities, risks, and corrective actions.
* Maintain accurate forecasts, opportunity pipelines, account activity, and customer information in the company's CRM.
* Identify and resolve service, quality, supply, and operational issues while protecting long-term customer relationships.
* Monitor market trends, competitive activity, customer strategies, and changing packaging requirements.
* Travel regularly to customer locations, Pratt facilities, trials, business reviews, and industry events.

**What You'll Get**

* Experience the satisfaction of driving company growth with sustainable solutions
* Benefit from a supportive team culture with growth and mentorship opportunities
* Be part of a professional culture operating with integrity and a commitment to safety
* Receive personal and professional benefits tailored to support your life

**Your Role at a Glance**

Success in this role comes from leveraging your:

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience
* Five to ten years of complex B2B, national-account, or enterprise sales experience
* Packaging, corrugated, manufacturing, consumer products, retail, or supply-chain experience preferred
* Demonstrated success managing multimillion-dollar accounts and complex sales cycles
* Experience leading RFPs, pricing negotiations, contracts, and executive business reviews
* Strong financial and commercial acumen, including margin and profitability management
* Ability to influence across functions without direct authority
* Proficiency with CRM, Microsoft 365, forecasting, and account-planning tools
* Willingness to travel, with an estimated travel percentage if known
* Valid driver's license and ability to transport samples, if genuinely essential

When you bring your commitment to growth and sustainability into our collaborative culture, we unlock endless opportunities for innovation and excellence.

**Ready to Make an Impact?**

If you're prepared to shape the future of sustainable packaging with us, apply now. Align your career with a company that values your contributions and is committed to your professional journey. Embark on a path that unboxes your best life at Pratt Industries.

Requirements:

Pratt Industries is America's 5th largest paper and packaging company with more than 8,000 highly skilled employees dedicated to the environment and sustainability. Pratt Industries is one of the largest corrugated packaging companies in America, with sophisticated manufacturing facilities in 26 states. The company operates four of the most modern, cost effective paper mills in the country, as well as a series of sheet and box plants strategically placed throughout the United States offering a wide range of creative packaging solutions. Pratt Industries is committed to recycling and the environment by “harvesting the urban forest."

jobs.description:
**Who We Are**
--------------

Pindrop is a cybersecurity company delivering continuous identity verification across voice, video, and digital interactions. Powered by the Pindrop Intelligence Network, our unified trust platform helps enterprises answer three critical questions:

**Is this identity synthetic?** Detect AI-generated and manipulated voice and video.  
**Is this identity risky?** Identify fraud, suspicious behavior, and other risk signals.  
**Is this identity known?** Authenticate identities using voice, device, behavioral, and other signals.

Pindrop brings this intelligence together across purpose-built trust engines to help organizations make informed decisions in real time — protecting customers, workforce interactions, and emerging AI-driven interactions.

Pindrop protects billions of high-risk interactions for enterprises, including leading financial institutions, insurers, and healthcare organizations. Its technology is informed by more than 8 billion real-world interactions annually and protected by 300+ patents.

Recognized by TIME as one of the 10 Most Influential Software Companies of 2026 and by Inc. for Best in Business for Innovation, Pindrop is backed by leading investors including Andreessen Horowitz, IVP, and CapitalG.

**What you'll do**
------------------

We're hiring an Executive Assistant to support our CEO as a trusted partner and operational extension. This role is for a seasoned, self-directed professional who operates with sound judgment and executive presence, and who moves work forward without needing to be asked. You'll manage time, priorities, and communication so the CEO and leadership team can stay focused on what drives the most impact. The best partners in this role know what's needed before it's requested, make confident decisions within their remit, and keep the CEO's attention for the things that truly require it.

Time and prioritization

* Own the CEO's calendar with a clear understanding of business priorities, and make scheduling decisions independently rather than routing routine choices back for approval.
* Protect focus time as a non-negotiable. When time is blocked, it stays blocked, and it is never converted into meetings without explicit direction.
* Keep meeting load sustainable by challenging low-value requests, consolidating where possible, and maintaining a realistic daily rhythm that preserves energy and thinking time.
* Design a lean, purposeful cadence of recurring touchpoints. Default to concise written updates over standing meetings, and reserve live time for topics that need the CEO's voice.

Judgment and decision-making

* Operate with delegated authority. When the CEO says to go ahead, you decide, act, and inform afterward.
* Bring recommendations instead of open questions. When input is truly needed, present a clear point of view, the options considered, and the tradeoffs, so the CEO can approve in seconds.
* Know the CEO's preferences, standards, and priorities well enough to make the call he would make.

Scheduling, travel, and logistics

* Coordinate complex domestic and international travel, agendas, and briefings end to end, with details resolved before they become questions.
* Anticipate changes, resolve issues quickly and quietly, and ensure smooth transitions between engagements.

Preparation and follow-through

* Prepare meeting briefs, background materials, and talking points that are concise, insightful, and ready to use as delivered.
* Deliver finished work, not drafts that need rework. Presentation materials, speaker notes, and executive documents should reflect strong design sensibility and attention to brand, down to the final detail.
* Track decisions and action items to ensure consistent follow-up and accountability across the organization.

Communication and relationship management

* Draft and review internal communications that reflect the CEO's voice and intent with minimal editing.
* Serve as a liaison between the CEO, executive team, board members, and external partners, exercising discretion and offering informed perspective, not just relaying messages.
* Filter and prioritize inbound requests so the CEO sees what matters, when it matters.

Operational effectiveness

* Introduce lightweight systems that improve follow-through, communication, and visibility.
* Create structure that helps the CEO and leadership team move quickly without added complexity or added asks of the CEO.

Innovation and technology

* Use AI and modern productivity tools to streamline workflows, summarize materials, and enhance decision-making.
* Stay curious about new technology that can make executive operations smarter and faster.

Confidentiality and trust

* Handle sensitive information with discretion and professionalism.
* Build trusted relationships across all levels of the organization and maintain confidentiality at all times.

**Who you are**
---------------

* A polished, composed executive partner with strong taste, sound judgment, and the confidence to hold and share a point of view.
* Proactive by default. You anticipate needs, take the next step, and close loops without prompting.
* Self-sufficient and decisive. You are comfortable making calls, managing ambiguity, and keeping momentum without frequent check-ins.
* A skilled, efficient communicator who knows when to speak up and when to simply get it done.
* Skilled at managing up: you guide the CEO's time and priorities diplomatically and hold boundaries that protect his effectiveness.
* Comfortable balancing strategic support with hands-on execution.

**Your skill-set**

* Demonstrated ability to work independently with minimal direction and to exercise judgment on behalf of a senior executive.
* Proficiency with Google Workspace and Microsoft Office, plus calendaring, travel, and expense systems.
* Strong design and presentation sensibility; experienc

### **Overview**

Small and mid-sized business owners want a simpler, more affordable way to accept payments, and the Business Development Representative is the person who shows them one. Scheduled appointments and routed leads start your week, and the owners you meet in your territory keep it full from there. You sit down with each owner, learn how they take payments today, walk them through a better setup, and sign them on as a new account.

Proposals, pricing, and follow-up are handled from your home office. The rest of the week you are out meeting owners who have asked to hear from you. This search is handled by NextPlay Recruitment on behalf of a client in payment processing.

This role pays on performance, so each account you open lifts what you earn, with bonuses for strong months. Professionals who have carried a sales target before tend to ramp quickly here.

### **What You'll Do**

* Meet business owners at scheduled appointments across your territory
* Work the leads routed to you while building a pipeline of your own
* Review how each owner accepts payments and present a stronger option

* Stay with the owner until the new account is live and running smoothly

* Business-to-business, account, or outside sales experience with a record of new accounts won
* At ease talking with an owner about how money moves through their business

* Scheduled appointments and routed leads alongside the pipeline you build

* Performance based pay that grows with your results, plus bonuses for strong months

**Assistant Project Manager - HVAC**

**Position Overview**

As an Assistant Project Manager - HVAC, you'll support the successful execution of commercial HVAC and integrated mechanical projects by assisting the Project Manager in coordinating activities, ensuring alignment with scope, schedule, budget, and quality standards, while focusing on HVAC system design, installation, and performance. This role contributes to delivering high-performance, sustainable mechanical outcomes for clients in commercial and critical environments across any of our operating companies. * Support development and maintenance of project schedules, milestones, and resource allocation using industry-standard tools.
* Track project costs, prepare cost projections, monitor budgets, and assist in identifying and managing variances, change orders, or value engineering opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams (field technicians, engineers, installers, subcontractors), vendors, and clients to ensure timely procurement, submittals, approvals, fabrication, and installation of HVAC equipment and components.
* Monitor project progress through regular site visits, report on status, risks, issues, safety compliance, and performance metrics to the Project Manager and stakeholders.
* Assist in quality control/assurance processes, ensuring compliance with project specifications, company standards, codes (e.g., ASHRAE, IMC), regulatory requirements, and safety protocols.

* Support risk identification and mitigation efforts related to HVAC scope, equipment performance, technical integration, and project delivery.
* Contribute to client communication, attend progress meetings, and provide updates on HVAC system status, commissioning, and performance.
* Participate in project handover, system startup/commissioning support, testing/balancing coordination, and post-project reviews to drive continuous improvement and lessons learned.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

None (this role has no direct supervisory responsibilities but requires close collaboration with project managers, field teams, and other departments; may involve guiding or mentoring junior staff or interns as needed).

**Requirements/Qualifications**

* **Experience**: 2+ years of experience in project coordination, assistant project management, or field/operations roles within HVAC, mechanical contracting, construction, or related industries. Recent graduates with engineering or construction management degrees who have relevant experience or strong interest in commercial HVAC are encouraged to apply.
* **Education**: Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* **Certifications/Licenses**: Valid driver's license and clean driving record required; OSHA 10/30-hour certification encouraged (company support provided).
* **Physical Demands**: Primarily office-based with frequent job-site visits; ability to walk active construction sites, climb ladders/stairs, lift light materials (plans, laptop), and travel regionally as needed.

This is a safety-sensitive position.

**Required Skills**

* Familiarity with commercial HVAC systems (chillers, boilers, air handlers, VAV systems, rooftop units, piping/ductwork) and integration with other building systems preferred.
* Understanding of project management principles, including scheduling, cost control, procurement, and risk management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Project, Word); experience with project management software (Procore, Autodesk BIM 360, Bluebeam, or similar) is a plus.
* Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with keen attention to detail.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal abilities to collaborate across multidisciplinary teams, subcontractors, and clients.
* Ability to travel to project sites as required and work in a fast-paced, field-oriented environment.

**Modigent Overview**

Modigent is a national leader delivering next-generation infrastructure, technology, and energy solutions through our family of specialized brands in HVAC, plumbing, and controls systems. With a strong coast-to-coast presence and extensive service capabilities, we empower customers, communities, and our over 1,500 team members to thrive with sustainable, efficient commercial building services. As part of our team, you'll contribute to thoughtful innovation and our people-first culture rooted in service, collaboration, and integrity.

**Why Work at Modigent**

jobs.description:
**About Us**
------------

  

Georgia Tech prides itself on its technological resources, collaborations, high-quality student body, and its commitment to building an outstanding and diverse community of learning, discovery, and creation. We strongly encourage applicants whose values align with our institutional values, as outlined in our strategic plan. These values include academic excellence, diversity of thought and experience, inquiry and innovation, collaboration and community, and ethical behavior and stewardship. Georgia Tech has policies to promote a healthy work-life balance and is aware that attracting faculty may require meeting the needs of two careers.

**About Georgia Tech**
  
Georgia Tech is a top-ranked public research university situated in the heart of Atlanta, a diverse and vibrant city with numerous economic and cultural strengths. The Institute serves more than 45,000 students through top-ranked undergraduate, graduate, and executive programs in engineering, computing, science, business, design, and liberal arts. Georgia Tech's faculty attracted more than $1.4 billion in research awards this past year in fields ranging from biomedical technology to artificial intelligence, energy, sustainability, semiconductors, neuroscience, and national security. Georgia Tech ranks among the nation's top 20 universities for research and development spending and No. 1 among institutions without a medical school.

**Georgia Tech's Mission and Values**
  
Georgia Tech's mission is to develop leaders who advance technology and improve the human condition. The Institute has nine key values that are foundational to everything we do:

1. Students are our top priority.

2. We strive for excellence.

3. We thrive on diversity.

4. We celebrate collaboration.

5. We champion innovation.

6. We safeguard freedom of inquiry and expression.

7. We nurture the well-being of our community.

8. We act ethically.

9. We are responsible stewards.

Over the next decade, Georgia Tech will become an example of inclusive innovation, a leading technological research university of unmatched scale, relentlessly committed to serving the public good; breaking new ground in addressing the biggest local, national, and global challenges and opportunities of our time; making technology broadly accessible; and developing exceptional, principled leaders from all backgrounds ready to produce novel ideas and create solutions with real human impact.

**About the School of Civil & Environmental Engineering at the Georgia Institute of Technology**

Twenty-six faculty members hold endowed chairs or professorships with 30% of them being women faculty. The School's Strategic Vision is available at www.ce.gatech.edu/strategic-vision. We are a vibrant and intellectually diverse School, with people who are using new technologies to expand the notion of what it means to be civil and environmental engineers in the 21st Century. Our program focuses on learning how to think, how to solve problems, and how to impact society for the better. **Department**

BSD IPP - MOSAAIC

**About the Department**

The Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH), located in the Biological Sciences Division, integrates a wide spectrum of factors such as human health behaviors, environmental factors, social and economic factors, policies and genetic determinants of health, into studies focused on the treatment and prevention of disease, as well as the maintenance of wellness. Leveraging and integrating the University of Chicago’s considerable institutional strength in population science with research spanning diverse fields such as genetic medicine, cancer epidemiology, microbiome, and epigenomics, the Institute will have the common goal of improving human health outcomes. Another major goal of the Institute will be to develop a new multidisciplinary training program to equip researchers with emerging tools and methods to conduct precision health research within a population health framework. Our faculty lead research projects in biostatistics, epidemiology and health services research and participate in interdisciplinary teams with faculty in other departments to address complex problems in health and healthcare, in our communities and around the globe.

**Job Summary**

The University of Chicago's Institute for Population and Precision Health (IPPH) is seeking a Clinical Research Coordinator 2 to support its portfolio of federally funded population health research, with a primary focus on the Multi-ethnic Observational Study in American Asian and Pacific Islander Communities (MOSAAIC) — a landmark NHLBI-funded epidemiological cohort study aimed at addressing critical gaps in cardiovascular, metabolic, pulmonary, and mental health research for Asian American, Native Hawaiian, and Pacific Islander communities.  
  
The University of Chicago serves as one of five national clinical and community field centers for MOSAAIC, with a goal of enrolling 2,000 Chicago-area participants through community-based outreach, mobile data collection, clinical phenotyping, and biospecimen collection. The study collects data across a broad range of health domains, including heart health, diabetes, lung health, and mental health, as well as social determinants of health such as environmental exposures and access to care. The Clinical Research Coordinator 2 will support the full research lifecycle across this and related IPPH studies — including participant recruitment and retention, IRB compliance, data and specimen collection, quality control, and milestone reporting — working closely with Scientific Directors and the Research Manager to advance research that promotes health equity and reduces disparities in historically underrepresented populations.

* Uses knowledge of clinical studies to coordinate the collection of analyzable clinical research data and/or samples with a limited to moderate degree of independence. Contributes to the problem solving on assigned clinical research studies and tasks.
* Performs other related work as needed.

This is a high-activity, outbound Sales Development role. You’ll be responsible for creating a sales pipeline by researching target accounts, reaching prospects through phone, email, LinkedIn, and other channels, and booking qualified meetings for Account Executives.

It is a focused top-of-funnel role for someone who is energized by prospecting, fast feedback loops, daily activity goals, and a team environment where performance is visible and celebrated. This is not an inbound or full-cycle sales role.

You’ll learn Rippling’s full platform, understand the operational pain points our customers face, and build the foundation for a long-term career in sales. Successful SDRs typically spend time in-seat developing core prospecting, discovery, objection-handling, and territory-management skills before furthering their sales career.  
  
***(This is a hybrid role and you will be required to be in the office 3x per week in Chicago, IL)***

**What you'll do**
------------------

* Research target companies, personas, business triggers, and operational pain points to identify high-quality prospecting opportunities
* Prospect into target accounts using phone, email, LinkedIn, and sales engagement tools
* Own a high-volume outbound motion, including daily call blocks, email follow-ups, account research, and multi-touch sequences
* Work toward clear daily and weekly activity expectations, including roughly 80–100 calls and 40–50 emails per day, depending on territory priorities and team guidance
* Qualify prospects using defined criteria and schedule high-quality meetings for Account Executives
* Partner closely with Account Executives on territory strategy, account prioritization, messaging, and follow-ups
* Participate actively in weekly enablement sessions, team call reviews, and manager coaching; apply feedback quickly to improve your messaging, objection handling, and overall prospecting effectiveness
* Maintain accurate records in Salesforce and keep outreach, account, and prospect data clean
* Leverage tools like Salesforce, Outreach, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Apollo, and dialer technology to execute efficiently

**Qualifications**
------------------

* BA/BS degree or equivalent work experience
* A high sense of urgency and genuine interest in a sales career
* Strong communication skills, especially over the phone and in concise, written outreach
* Coachability - you can take feedback, apply it quickly, and improve from one call to the next
* Curiosity and initiative - you ask good questions, seek context, and look for ways to get better without waiting to be told
* Resilience and consistency in a high-activity prospecting environment
* Comfort working toward measurable goals in a competitive, team-oriented setting
* Ability to collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, and other teams
* Prior sales, customer-facing, athletics, or competitive team experience is helpful, but not required

**What success looks like**

In your first 30 days, you’ll focus on onboarding, product knowledge, sales methodology, tools, messaging, and understanding Rippling’s customers.

By month two, you’ll begin ramping into live prospecting, building activity consistency, and working toward partial quota expectations.

By month three, you should be operating at full ramp expectations, managing daily outbound activity, booking qualified meetings, and showing consistent improvement through coaching and repetition.

Longer term, success in this role means building the skills and track record to grow your sales career at Rippling - whether that path is toward Account Executive, SDR leadership, or another go-to-market role.

**Why join Rippling**

* You’ll sell a product that solves real operational problems for companies - not a narrow point solution
* You’ll learn how businesses run across HR, IT, Finance, payroll, benefits, devices, apps, and more
* You’ll join a fast-paced, high-performance sales environment with strong coaching, clear goals, and room to grow
* You’ll be part of a collaborative SDR team that values healthy competition, accountability, and continuous improvement
You’ll get exposure to a rapidly expanding platform, including newer product areas such as AI and data

jobs.description:
At RES, we're looking for purpose-driven individuals who are passionate about restoration and sustainability, and who want their work to make a lasting environmental impact. Our team members go above and beyond, bringing initiative, integrity, and a strong work ethic to every project. Collaboration is key—we thrive on teamwork, open communication, and diverse perspectives. In a field that constantly changes, we value those who are resilient, adaptable, and resourceful in the face of challenges. If you're intellectually curious, eager to learn, and ready to help restore ecosystems and protect natural resources, you'll find your place here.

**RES** is seeking a **Client Solutions Manager** that will market integrated delivery projects directly to prospects and clients in mitigation, water quality, and resilience. The position is vital to the region's sales and business development function and promotes RES solutions throughout the Southeast region, including North Carolina, South Carolina, Tennessee, and Georgia. You'll serve as the face of RES to clients, agencies, and industry partners, helping identify and close opportunities for ecological restoration, water quality, and resilieace solutions. This role blends relationship-building, strategic planning, and technical insight to position RES as a trusted advisor and industry leader.

### **Why You'll Love This Job**

* You'll be on the front lines of delivering real environmental results—through deals that matter.
* You'll collaborate with dynamic internal teams—from design and regulatory to finance and construction—to bring projects to life.
* You'll grow your professional network while engaging public agencies, private developers, consultants, and non-profits.
* You'll represent RES at conferences and industry forums, becoming a key voice in restoration innovation

**A Day in the Life**

You'll work closely with land, regulatory, design, and project teams to pursue and win business opportunities in your assigned market. This includes identifying qualified leads, managing external relationships, and leading proposal development and deal structuring. You'll track permitting timelines, understand deal components, manage cross-functional resources, and represent RES during key client meetings and industry events.

From guiding internal teams on project pursuit strategy to presenting financial summaries to clients, you'll be the connector between RES capabilities and market opportunities—bringing deals from idea to execution.

Expect to travel regionally to visit project sites, meet with regulators and clients, and represent RES at conferences and partner events.

**We would love to talk to you if you have many of the following:**

* BS/BA in Environmental Science, Business, Engineering, or related field
* 3+ years of experience in a related industry, dealing with complex solutions with multi-year sales cycle and multiple stakeholders
* Experience assessing and managing project timelines, identifying risks, and aligning teams to meet deliverables
* Experience interpreting financial models and communicating financial health of deals
* Experience with contracts and key provisions; legal awareness in deal structuring

### **You will thrive in this position if you:**

* Love building lasting relationships and solving complex client challenges
* Are comfortable presenting to both technical and non-technical audiences
* Communicate clearly in writing and in person—and know when to bring in the right internal experts
* Can read the room, adapt your approach, and keep pushing forward with resilience and urgency

**What Will Make You Stand Out**

* Experience with relevant environmental regulations and permits/approvals (e.g. CWA 404/402/401, NWP/IP, NPDES, ESA)
* PMP or advanced training in project or deal management
* Knowledge of stream/wetland design and construction methods
* Relationships with local, state, and federal regulators in your region
* Experience in the review and preparation of regulatory documents and deliverables and responding to agency comments
* Experience with science, design and/or construction of wetlands

Please note that the "Day in the Life" section is not intended to be an exhaustive list of job duties, but rather a representative snapshot of typical responsibilities and work experiences at RES.

RES is an Equal Opportunity Employer and a VEVRAA Federal Contractor. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
C.H. Robinson is seeking a **Business Development Representative** to join our Intermodal team. In this role you identify new opportunities within the Intermodal service line, and support the selling of creative solutions/services to drive growth through relationship building, problem solving, and providing exceptional service. You will be responsible for delivering customer commitments, resolving issues, driving continuous improvement and articulating customer value. You are responsible for the growth and retention of a customer portfolio or modal offering while also supporting new opportunities. You will use your knowledge of the customer’s business challenges and supply chain goals to develop tailored solutions, which deliver value and support the customer’s business.

This is a hybrid position with 4 days in-office in our Oakbrook Terrace, IL office.

**DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES**

The duties and responsibilities of this position consist of, but are not limited to, the following:

Strategy & Growth:

* Represents, develops, and enhances the brand
* Penetrates the assigned customer portfolio assigned, by making contacts and building relationships at multiple levels and in multiple departments within the account in partnership with account management, capacity, and/or service line teams.
* Conducts regular business reviews partnering with internal teams (ie, account management, capacity, service lines), leveraging internal analytics and market intelligence to gain customer insights, and understands positive and negative trends in data, to uncover new opportunities for growth, increase sales, and retain and grow the business by presenting solutions to help the customer win.
* Shares customer specific data, requirements and expectations with internal resources in order to collaboratively create viable supply chain solutions for customers
* Reviews of financial, volume and service performance reports and makes adjustments (pricing, process, etc.) that create efficiencies and drive continuous improvement
* Uses effective negotiation and sales strategies in discussing pricing and selling solutions
* Stays informed of changes within the customers’ business, industry and sector through regular customer communication; applies that knowledge to identify new opportunities

Customer Service:

* Serves as the primary point of contact, delivering a positive customer experience through proactive communication, timely responses and by applying the appropriate sense of urgency as the situation dictates

* Manages conflict and navigates difficult conversations, using tact and diplomacy
* Collaborates and actively communicates with partners on the commercial/ account management/ capacity/product/supply team regarding customer needs, issues and solutions in order to meet customer expectations
* Builds trusting relationships by ensuring quality execution against expectations and collaborating with internal partners to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner
* Uses effective negotiation and sales strategies in discussing pricing and selling services.
* Partners with commercial, account management and customers to gather information on inbound & outbound needs, and offers tailored solutions based on the CHR platform in order to build customer relationships and win business
* Stays informed and may respond to customer inquiries and provide updates related to exception management to articulate actions being taken

Execution leading to Quality:

* Monitors order statuses and initiates corrective action when exceptions occur (verifying pricing, weights, delivery times, ship quantities, load information, etc.)
* Understands customer workflows, preferences and SOPs and applies this knowledge to create efficient, cost effective solutions for the customer
* Provides ongoing issue resolution through communication with the customer and offers options and alternative solutions in a timely manner

Process Efficiency:

* Leverages customer facing technology to ensure the right technology is matched to customer needs
* Organizes and prioritizes opportunities utilizing sales management tools such as opportunity management, Atmosphere
* Uses internal tools and resources, including but not limited to service line and pricing SMEs, to determine customer pricing strategy
* Assists in the development of any SOPs required to manage the customers’ business effectively

Pricing:

* Collaborates in pricing strategy through a clear understanding of customer buying habits and CHR’s position within the customer’s supply chain
* Uses internal tools and resources, including but not limited to service line and pricing SMEs, to determine customer pricing strategy
* Collaborates with RFP opportunities for customers within portfolio

**QUALIFICATIONS**

Required:

* High School Diploma or GED
* Minimum 2 years of previous sales experience
* Ability to travel internationally and domestically

Preferred:

* Bachelor’s Degree from an accredited college or university
* Demonstrated negotiation and sales strategies experience
* Decision making and multi-tasking skills
* Effective and flexible communication and interpersonal skills
* Driven, enthusiastic, resilient, agile and highly motivated
* Ability to thrive under deadlines and drive results,
* Attention to detail and analytical ability
* High comfort level with technology and the ability to quickly learn new systems
* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite of programs
* Values a diverse and inclusive work environment

We will review applications for this role on an ongoing basis and encourage all interested candidates to apply at their earliest convenience.

**Compensation Range**

$32.16 - $50.81

The base pay range displayed on the job posting reflects the minimum and maximum base pay for this specific location. Your individual base pay within this range is determined by job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Compensation details listed in this posting

jobs.description:
Studio & Fulfillment Assistant | Part-Time

**Render Goods | Chicago, IL | $22/hour**

**Monday–Friday | Starting 20 Hours per Week | Flexible Scheduling**

About the Role:

Render Goods is looking for a reliable, organized, and hands-on person to help with the day-to-day operations of our Chicago housewares studio.

This is a part-time, in-person position working directly alongside me, the founder, to keep orders moving, products looking their best, and daily studio operations running smoothly.

The role is a mix of order fulfillment, light product production, inventory organization, and general logistical support. Some days will involve packing and shipping orders, while others might include preparing products for retail, assembling packaging, running production machines, organizing inventory, or general studio upkeep.

We're a small, growing business, so no two days are exactly alike! I'm looking for someone who enjoys working with their hands, has a good eye for detail, and is comfortable jumping between different tasks as needed.

**While we're initially hiring for a general studio assistant, we're hoping to find someone who can grow with us.** Render is entering an exciting new chapter of growth, and we'd love to find a long-term team member whose interests, experience, and individual strengths could eventually contribute to the business in a more meaningful way.

If you have additional skills in e-commerce, Shopify, graphic design, photography, email marketing, or creative production, we'd love to hear about them! These skills aren't required for the initial position, but we're interested in learning what else you could bring to the table as the role evolves.

About Render Goods

Render Goods is a woman-owned, Chicago-based housewares studio creating thoughtfully designed everyday essentials from recycled, biodegradable, and otherwise responsibly sourced materials.

Our collection includes colorful dish towels made from recycled plastic bottles, Swedish dishcloths, washcloths, and natural-fiber cleaning brushes. We sell through independent retailers, online, and at markets and events throughout the country.

Our Chicago studio serves as the home base for product development, light manufacturing, inventory, and fulfillment.

Schedule & Location

**Chicago, IL | West Town / Near West Side**

* Monday through Friday, approximately 20 hours per week.
* Flexible daytime scheduling to accommodate school, other work, or personal commitments.
* Consistent weekly availability is preferred, but exact hours can be arranged together.
* Some overlapping work hours are required, but independent working time in the studio is available to the right person
* Optional opportunities for additional weekend hours at markets and events (pending you have a car).
* Occasional opportunities to assist with larger Chicago events, including the One of a Kind Show, providing on-site setup, merchandising, and logistical support.

This is primarily a studio-based position, not a retail sales role.

Responsibilities

**Shipping & Order Fulfillment**

* Pick, pack, and prepare online and wholesale orders for shipment.
* Ensure orders are accurate, neatly packaged, and shipped on time.
* Print shipping labels, prepare cartons, and organize outgoing packages.
* Help maintain shipping supplies and packaging materials.
* Assist with larger wholesale orders and seasonal shipping volume.

**Product Finishing & Light Production**

* Assemble product packaging, labels, tags, and retail-ready materials.
* Inspect finished products for quality and presentation.
* Fold, bundle, package, and prepare products for retail and wholesale distribution.
* Assist with simple production and finishing tasks as needed.
* Help maintain consistency and quality across finished products.

**Studio Organization & Logistics**

* Receive deliveries, unpack shipments, and organize incoming inventory.
* Restock supplies and maintain an organized workspace.
* Prepare inventory and materials for markets, wholesale accounts, and special events.
* Assist with inventory counts and general stock organization.
* Help with miscellaneous studio projects and daily operational tasks.

**Events & Special Projects**

* Help prepare displays, merchandise, and supplies for upcoming events.
* Occasionally provide on-site assistance at larger Chicago markets and trade shows.
* Assist with new product development, samples, and creative projects as opportunities arise.

Requirements

* Reliable, punctual, organized, and detail-oriented.
* Comfortable working independently and following instructions.
* Good time management skills and ability to prioritize tasks.
* Strong attention to detail, particularly with packaging and order accuracy.
* Comfortable performing repetitive, hands-on tasks.
* Ability to lift and carry up to 40 lbs.
* Willingness to learn new processes and take initiative.
* Comfortable working directly with the founder in a small studio environment.
* Previous shipping, fulfillment, retail, or production experience is a plus, but not required.

Bonus Skills & Opportunities for Growth

No specialized experience is required beyond a willingness to learn, but we're especially interested in candidates who bring additional skills, creative interests, or experience that could help us grow.

Some areas we'd love to hear about include:

* **E-commerce & Shopify:** Online store management, product listings, merchandising, or order management.
* **Email Marketing & Digital Marketing:** Experience with email campaigns, customer outreach, social media, or content creation.
* **Photography & Content Creation:** Product photography, photo editing, styling, or creating visual content.
* **Graphic Design:** Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, packaging design, or print production.
* **Light Manufacturing:** CO2 laser engraving, screen printing, production equipment, or hands-on fabrication.

jobs.description:
**DEVELOPMENT ASSISTANT MIDWEST REGION**  
  
**About Us**  
Join our growing team at American Friends of the Hebrew University (AFHU), a national, not-for-profit organization whose mission is to support the Hebrew University of Jerusalem, one of the world’s most distinguished academic and research institutions. Its students, faculty, and alumni have won 10 Nobel Prizes, developed treatments for diseases, and ignited innovation that has led to more than 12,600 patents.
  
  
**About the Opportunity**  
The Midwest Region Development Assistant will report to the Regional Executive Director and will be an integral part of the Midwest fundraising team, providing support across fundraising, donor management, events, and regional operations.  
  
This is a hybrid position based in AFHU’s Midwest Region office in Chicago, Illinois, with a combination of in-office and remote work. The position will also require occasional evening and weekend availability for donor events and regional programs.  
  
**About You**  
The ideal candidate is a proactive, collaborative, and detail-oriented professional who is highly organized, flexible, and comfortable managing multiple priorities. They enjoy working closely with colleagues on a small, growing team in a mission-driven environment and bring professionalism, sound judgment, and a strong commitment to supporting fundraising and donor engagement.  
  
**Position Responsibilities:**  
  
**Fundraising Support**

* Development Operations and Gift Administration:
  + Manage the Midwest Region’s core gift administration and development operations accurately, consistently, and in a timely manner.
  + This includes gift coding and documentation, donor acknowledgements and thank-you letters, tribute correspondence, donor recognition, donation tracking, donor reporting and stewardship materials, and other required gift-processing activities.
* Raiser’s Edge, Donor Interaction Tracking, and Reporting:
  + Strong knowledge of Raiser’s Edge to ensure that the Midwest Region maintains accurate, current, and useful donor and prospect records.
  + This includes maintaining constituent information, recording gifts, stewardship activities, event participation, donor correspondence, and other appropriate actions; and ensuring relevant documentation is attached to constituent records.
* Donor Stewardship and Follow-Through:
  + Provide consistent administrative support for Midwest donor stewardship, including donor acknowledgements, thank-you letters, donor reports, recognition correspondence, donor calls as assigned, stewardship materials, and appropriate follow-up.

**Event and Meeting Support**

* Event, Board Meeting, and Hebrew University Visitor Execution:
  + Serve as the primary administrative and logistical support for Midwest events, donor gatherings, Board meetings, and visits from Hebrew University faculty, content experts, and senior leadership.

**General Administration**

* Executive Director and Regional Administrative Support:
  + Provide reliable administrative support to the Executive Director and Midwest Region, including monthly expense reports, invoices and financial documentation, meeting materials, scheduling and logistical support as appropriate, regional communications, filing and organizational systems, and other administrative responsibilities.
* Special projects as assigned

**Qualifications**

The Los Angeles Parks Foundation (LAPF) is the primary nonprofit partner of the City of Los Angeles Department of Recreation and Parks (RAP). Founded in 2008, LAPF raises private philanthropic support to enhance, expand, and champion the more than 500 parks and recreation centers stewarded by the City of Los Angeles.

LAPF is in an active growth phase, guided by a new 2026–2030 Strategic Plan and led by President & CEO Amber Martinez. The organization currently operates with a small staff and program and administrative consultants and is building toward a full operational team. The Administration & Grants Coordinator is a foundational hire — the role that keeps the day-to-day running smoothly so that program and development staff can focus on mission-driven work.

The Finance and Operations Coordinator supports the financial and operational functions of LAPF under the direction of the Deputy Director. This role is the organizational engine behind LAPF’s day-to-day administration: processing transactions, maintaining records, managing office systems, supporting the external accountant, and ensuring that the organization’s financial and operational infrastructure runs accurately and on time.

LAPF works with an external accountant for bookkeeping and tax filings. The Finance and Operations Coordinator is the internal point of contact for that relationship, gathering documentation, processing receipts and invoices, and ensuring the accountant has what they need to produce clean and timely financial reports. The Deputy Director reviews financial statements and manages the budget; this role supports that process with accurate, well-organized underlying data.

This is a detail-oriented, systems-minded role in a small, mission-driven organization. The right person takes pride in accurate records, well-run processes, and a tidy office — and finds satisfaction in being the person the rest of the team can count on to keep things organized.

Board and committee coordination, drafting materials and minutes, organizational scheduling and meeting logistics,

* Coordinate routine facilities needs and serve as the Foundation's administrative point of contact for issues related to the Griffith Park Nursery House.
* Maintain organizational calendars and coordinate internal scheduling and meeting logistics as directed by the Deputy Director.
* Maintain shared administrative systems and organizational files, ensuring current contracts, agreements, insurance certificates, policies, and other key documents are organized and accessible.
